releases.body:
Tattoo Review, now filming at Tattoo Factory of Charlotte, the newest addition to The Tattoo Factory chain of tattoo shops. The studio is located at 5237 Albemarle Road, Suite 106, Charlotte, NC 28212. More information is available at tattoofactoryofcharlotte.com.

CHARLOTTE, N.C., Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- KAOZ TV LLC and City View Films have transitioned the reality series Tattoo Review into a full-length episodic format, documenting the daily operations of Tattoo Factory of Charlotte. Moving beyond the limitations of micro-content, the series provides an authentic look at professional body art culture, prioritizing artist-client collaboration over staged competition formats. The new show will include piercings as well as tattoos.

Prospective clients and viewers can access studio updates and service information at https://tattoofactoryofcharlotte.com

The expanded series explores the technical and personal narratives found within a high-volume studio. A primary differentiator in the new format is the inclusion of both tattoos and professional piercing services, offering a comprehensive view of the body art industry. Each episode tracks the progression from initial consultation and design to the final procedure, providing a practical resource for first-time clients and a behind-the-scenes look for enthusiasts. By focusing on the day-to-day pace of a working North Carolina studio, the production highlights the reality of the client experience.

"We are presenting the authentic, unfiltered energy of our new Charlotte tattoo studio to a wider audience through Tattoo Review," said Derek Van Cleve, owner of Tattoo Factory of Charlotte. "By moving away from staged competition tropes and focusing on the genuine connection between our artists and their clients, we are offering viewers a rare look at the dedication behind every tattoo and piercing."

Multi-platform distribution

To ensure broad accessibility, the series utilizes a strategic distribution network:

  • Digital & Social: Viewers can access content via YouTube and Facebook, with additional streaming availability on KLIPZ TV.
  • Broadcast Syndication: Full-length episodes are syndicated on KAOZ TV, connecting the production with both the local North Carolina market and a national audience.

This multi-channel approach allows viewers to engage with the series through their preferred medium, whether on social media, streaming devices, or traditional television.

releases.title: Korein Tillery Files Lawsuit on Behalf of Music Artists Against AI Music-Generation Platform Suno
releases.body:
Lawsuit alleges Suno built a name-indexed music platform that commercially exploits musicians' identities without consent, seeks to protect musicians' rights in the age of AI

CHICAGO, Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Korein Tillery has filed a new lawsuit in the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts. The lawsuit is filed on behalf of acclaimed musician Jason Isbell and other music artists representing a proposed class of similarly situated musicians whose identities have been appropriated and commercially exploited without consent by AI music-generation platform Suno, Inc. The lawsuit asserts claims under a number of state right-of-publicity laws and the Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act.

The case, Jason Isbell, et al. v. Suno, Inc., alleges that Suno designed, trained, and commercially deployed a platform built to retrieve musicians by name and provide a multi-media experience evoking those musicians' identities on command. The complaint includes dozens of demonstrations and exhibits of Suno providing—based on musicians' names alone—songs like one the named musician might make, descriptions of the musicians' attributes, and related images (e.g. a white glove for the artist Michael Jackson). According to the complaint, Suno provides these outputs for musicians whose talents span blues, rock, country, alternative, reggaeton, rap, pop, salsa, Hawaiian, ska punk, and alt-country-punk fusion. 

The lawsuit also alleges that Suno, without consent, created and stored voiceprints indexed by name when training its AI on musicians' voices.

"Despite its assertions that Suno did not train its AI on specific musicians' identities and does not allow artists' names as prompts, its own public-facing product shows otherwise," said George A. Zelcs, Partner at Korein Tillery. "Further, Suno's own licensing agreements with major music companies expressly recognize that a copyright license does not supply the separate consent required from the human creators whose identities have been commercially exploited. It's time for musicians to have a seat at the table. We will work vigorously to protect their right to control the use of their own identities." 

The Korein Tillery legal team on this matter includes George A. Zelcs, Audrey L. C. Austin, Marc Wallenstein, and Lucy Prather.

About Korein Tillery

Korein Tillery is an AV-rated, award-winning law firm with offices in St. Louis, Chicago, and Naples. The firm has recovered billions of dollars in verdicts and settlements by aggressively pursuing complex civil cases. Korein Tillery has been named by the National Law Journal as one of the nation's top plaintiffs' law firms.

Case Information

releases.title: Come Talk To ME, Featuring AI-Recreated Voice, Selected for Twin Cities Film Fest
releases.body:
Documentary brings Parkinson's conversations to film festivals and communities

MINNEAPOLIS, Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Come Talk To ME, the feature-length (76 min) documentary by independent filmmaker and director Deacon Warner and first-time producer Jackie Hunt Christensen, has been selected to be part of the Twin Cities Film Fest, Oct. 15-24. The film is also currently available for community screenings worldwide through Kinema, a streaming platform that allows groups to license the film for both in-person and virtual screenings.

Come Talk To ME follows Parkinson's disease (PD) activist Jackie Hunt Christensen, her husband Paul Christensen, their two sons, and a diverse group of friends with PD. Their stories reflect on the many types of communication that are necessary to participate fully in relationships as the disease progresses.

In a groundbreaking approach, Jackie uses artificial intelligence (AI) to recreate her voice as it sounded two years after her diagnosis in 1998 but before the disease had noticeably impacted her speech. This AI-generated voice, dubbed "JHC2K," asks questions written by Jackie's present-day self and also serves as the film's narrator. 

The documentary offers an intimate look at Jackie and Paul's journey, including reflections from their two now-grown sons on how 28 years of Parkinson's have shaped their family dynamic. It also captures Jackie's behind-the-scenes efforts to produce the film, including a trip to an international summit for Parkinson's support group leaders in Austin, Texas, where she and Paul conducted interviews.

Throughout the production, Jackie and Paul face new challenges, but Jackie remains deeply committed to completing the film and raising awareness about how Parkinson's impacts communication and relationships, particularly affecting care partners.

The filmmakers are especially eager for the film to be viewed in settings that allow post-screening discussions, such as film festivals and community-hosted screenings. "I showed [Come Talk To ME] to a group of 23. Every person in the room shared that it was relevant in their life. Everyone should see this," said screening host Kari Kielblock. 

Viewer Marna Anderson described the film as, "a realistic and beautiful look at a family who is learning to love more deeply through a painful and difficult disease. It also provided excellent information and resources for viewers."

Screening Details:

Come Talk TO ME screens at 12 pm on October 24 at Edina Mann Theatre (3911 W. 50th St.

Edina, MN 55424) as part of the Twin Cities Film Fest, which runs Oct 15-24. The Twin Cities Film Fest is headquartered at Marcus West End Cinema, 1625 Park Place Blvd., St. Louis Park, MN 55416.

Anyone interested in hosting a screening of Come Talk To ME can do so directly through the film's Kinema page. Prospective hosts can also contact the film's director: director@cometalktomefilm.com

Visit the film's website to learn more about the film, find Parkinson's disease resources as well as find information about hosting a screening: cometalktomefilm.com

About the Filmmakers

Producer Jackie Hunt Christensen became a Parkinson's disease activist when she was diagnosed with the disease. She has published two guide books on the disease, The First Year---Parkinson's Disease: An Essential Guide for the Newly Diagnosed (2005) and Life With a Battery-Operated Brain: A Patient's Guide to Deep Brain Stimulation Surgery for Parkinson's Disease (2009).

At the time she was diagnosed at 34, Jackie was Co-Director of the Food and Health program at the Institute for Agriculture & Trade Policy in Minneapolis, Minnesota, as well as a co-founder and Co-Director of Health Care Without Harm (HCWH): The Campaign for Environmentally Responsible Health Care. She continued working for both organizations until June 2004, when, at age 40, her PD symptoms forced her to leave her jobs and apply for disability benefits.

Director Deacon Warner is a documentary filmmaker and youth media instructor. He has been teaching media arts since 2008. As an independent filmmaker, Deacon has directed numerous short documentaries including Bee-Sharp Honeybee, Literacy for Freedom: Empowering Black Boys in MN and Every Day Is a Parade. Deacon's first feature documentary, The Co-op Wars, premiered at the Minneapolis St Paul International Film Festival in 2021.

releases.title: Storiad Introduces the Author Marketing OS
releases.body:
New software category gives authors a unified system to plan, execute and manage book marketing

CHARLESTON, S.C., Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Storiad today introduced the Author Marketing OS, a new category of software designed to give authors a single system for planning, executing and managing the marketing of their books.

Authors have never had more tools available to market their books. They have social media platforms, email services, advertising platforms, AI tools, websites, databases and countless other resources. Yet those tools remain largely disconnected, leaving authors to figure out how to organize the entire job of marketing a book themselves.

Storiad's premise is simple: authors don't need more marketing tools. They need a system for using them.

"Authors are expected to market their books like businesses, but they've never really had that kind of software businesses use to manage their marketing," said Ramzi S. Hajj, founder of Storiad. "We've had writing software. We've had publishing software. We've had thousands of individual marketing tools. What we've been missing is an operating system for the whole job of marketing a book."

A New Category for an Old Problem

Marketing a book involves far more than creating a few social media posts or sending emails to a limited list.

Authors need to identify their target readers, establish marketing goals, develop a strategy, create promotional materials, find relevant media and industry contacts, conduct outreach, follow up, maintain visibility and measure what is working.

Those activities have traditionally been handled across multiple tools, documents and services.

Storiad brings them together in a single platform designed specifically around the author's book marketing workflow.

The company defines an Author Marketing OS as "a unified system that organizes the major functions of book marketing, including strategy, planning, execution and optimization." Rather than replacing every marketing tool an author may use, the Storiad OS provides the strategic and operational structure that connects those activities.

Storiad is introducing the Author Marketing OS as a new software category built specifically around the job of marketing a book.

From Strategy to Execution

At the center of Storiad's approach is Book Promotion nMotion™, a proprietary system that helps authors turn a book marketing strategy into an actionable campaign.

Book Promotion nMotion™ organizes promotion around eight core areas:

  • Promotional Asset Creation
  • Market Research
  • Social Media Management
  • Emailing & Follow-up
  • Networking
  • Marketing
  • Publicity
  • Blogging & Newsletter

For each area, authors can develop strategies, planning documents and step-by-step checklists designed to move their campaigns from ideas to action.

"There's a really big difference between giving an author a marketing plan and giving an author a system they can actually use to run the campaign," said Hajj. "Our goal is to make book marketing something an author can learn, organize, execute and improve upon over time."

Built Around the Author's Book Sales Goal

Storiad begins with a simple question for the author:

How many books do you want to sell?

Its Book Sales Calculator helps authors establish a specific sales target and understand the marketing activities required to pursue it. From there, the platform provides tools and workflows for building and managing a campaign around that book sales goal.

The platform includes CRM-style contact management, a database of more than 52,000 verified book promotion contacts, marketing planning tools such as a Target Reader Profile, email outreach, social media tools, an author website builder, a press room, publicity resources, campaign management and other book marketing capabilities.

Storiad is being used by thousands of authors, giving the company real-time experience developing software around the practical challenges authors face when promoting their books.

AI as Part of the Marketing System

The Author Marketing OS also incorporates StoriA, Storiad's AI Author Assistant.

StoriA is designed to help authors work through the marketing process, from developing strategies and plans to creating marketing materials and determining what to do next.

"AI is very good at creating things," said Hajj. "But creating another piece of content isn't necessarily the answer to an author's marketing problem. The bigger questions center around who should I reach, what should I say, what should I do next, and how does this fit into my overall campaign? That's where we think AI can become much more useful to authors."

Building the Author Marketing OS

The need for an Author Marketing OS comes from a simple reality of today's publishing environment: authors are increasingly responsible for marketing their own books.

At the same time, the number of tools available to them continues to grow.

Storiad believes the answer is not another standalone marketing tool.

It is a system.

"The ultimate goal is pretty simple," said Hajj. "We want to help authors take control of their book marketing and sell more books."

Storiad is making its Author Marketing OS available to authors through its software platform.

For more information, visit www.storiad.com.

About Storiad

Storiad is the first Author Marketing Operating System, designed to help published authors plan, execute and manage their entire book marketing lifecycle in one place. The platform combines marketing strategy, structured workflows, AI-powered assistance, CRM-style contact management, research, outreach and campaign execution.

Storiad's mission is simple: help authors sell more books.

Founder & CEO, Storiad, Inc.

NEW YORK, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Tickets are on sale now to see "Jim Henson's Harmonious Hoopla" – a madcap musical revue featuring the songs you know and love from your favorite worlds of Jim Henson. With music from Fraggle Rock, Labyrinth, Emmet Otter's Jug-Band Christmas, and more, this special tribute will be performed on two nights only: Thursday, September 24th, and Friday, September 25th, as part of Museum of Moving Image's celebration of Jim Henson's 90th birthday. Tickets are available now at movingimage.org, and MoMI members receive discounted tickets.

From The Jim Henson Company and Heather Henson, "Jim Henson's Harmonious Hoopla" stars Henson performers Jordan Brownlee (television: Slumberkins; stage: Emmet Otter's Jug-Band Christmas), Aymee Garcia (television: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock; stage: Wicked, Into the Woods), and Leslie Carrara-Rudolph (television: Muppets Tonight, stage: Puppet Up!, Wake Up Your Weird) as they perform memorable and iconic songs from the legacy of Jim Henson with a live band, puppets from Jim Henson's Creature Shop, and a lot of fun. With songs from Jim Henson's best-known films, as well as the theme songs and favorites from his television classics, and with a few surprises along the way, it is sure to be a joyful evening for fans of all ages that is not to be missed.

"Jim Henson's Harmonious Hoopla" is from The Jim Henson Company and Heather Henson. The show is directed by John Tartaglia (television: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock; stage: Avenue Q, Shrek the Musical) and produced by Brenna Ross (stage: Ajijaak on Turtle Island, Green Feather Foundation), with musical direction from Paul Rudolph (television: Sesame Street, Julie's Greenroom).

About The Jim Henson Company

The Jim Henson Company has remained an established leader in family entertainment for over 70 years and is recognized as an innovator in puppetry, animatronics, and digital animation. The Company's most recent credits include the Amazon Kids+ series Jim Henson's Monster Dance, the PBS KIDS special Wowsabout, the hit holiday special for Apple TV The First Snow of Fraggle Rock, and the Emmy-nominated Alexander and the Terrible, Horrible, No Good, Very Bad Road Trip for Disney+, as well as the Oscar®-winning Guillermo Del Toro's Pinocchio for Netflix, and the Emmy®-winning Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock for Apple TV. Other television credits include Slumberkins and Harriet the Spy for Apple TV; Dinosaur Train, Splash and Bubbles, and Sid the Science Kid all for PBS; Earth to Ned for Disney+; and the Netflix series Word Party and the Emmy-winning The Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance. Iconic catalogue titles include Fraggle Rock, The Storyteller, Farscape, and the ground-breaking fantasy classics The Dark Crystal and Labyrinth.

Headquartered in Los Angeles with additional locations in New York and London, the Company is also home to Jim Henson's Creature Shop™, a pre-eminent puppet and creature-building group and industry leader in puppeteered digital animation, with international film, television, theme park, and advertising clients.

About Heather Henson

Heather Henson is a producer, puppet artist, and creative steward whose work centers on connection—to one another, to the natural world, and to the sense of wonder she grew up with through the Muppets. Through the Green Feather Foundation, she creates environmental puppet theater and fosters independent artists through Handmade Puppet Dreams, the Puppet Slam Network, and the Jim Henson Carriage House, where new puppet works are developed in collaboration with the Jim Henson Foundation. Her philanthropic and investment work supports Indigenous communities, environmental stewardship, regenerative initiatives, and creative projects that help build a more connected and sustainable world. Heather is President of the Jane Henson Foundation, Chair of the Jim Henson Legacy, and a shareholder and board member of The Jim Henson Company.

releases.title: Xanh Entertainment Inc. Introduces EscapeSquid Virtual-to-Destination Tournament and Travel Platform
releases.body:
NEWARK, Del., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- EscapeSquid, developed by Xanh Entertainment Inc., is building a virtual-to-destination entertainment and travel platform designed to connect online competitions with live immersive experiences, destination events, hotel stays, and travel.

Built around the concept "Play. Connect. Explore.", EscapeSquid is developing a year-round model where participants can compete in virtual challenges, advance through tournaments and leaderboards, and then move on to real experiences in destination markets.

EscapeSquid plans to develop regional and destination programs across major U.S. markets, with opportunities for hotels, entertainment venues, tour operators, education partners, and other travel partners to participate in the platform's growing network.

"Our goal is to turn online participation into a reason to travel," said John Phung, Founder and CEO of Xanh Entertainment Inc. "EscapeSquid is designed to connect the excitement of competition with memorable destination experiences."

The EscapeSquid 60 Minutes Challenge

At the center of the Tournament Series is the EscapeSquid 60 Minutes Challenge, an interactive competition.

Participants will compete through virtual and live challenges, earn leaderboard points, and have opportunities to advance to regional and destination events, culminating in a national championship.

Play — Participate in virtual and live challenges that combine entertainment, problem-solving, gaming, fitness, and competition.

Connect — Meet teammates, competitors, entertainment partners, and communities through shared challenges and experiences.

Explore — Turn competition into travel by advancing from virtual participation to live entertainment and destination experiences.

"Our goal is to turn online participation into a reason to connect, compete, and travel," said John Phung, Founder and CEO of Xanh Entertainment Inc. "EscapeSquid is designed to create a bridge between virtual competition and memorable real-world experiences."

A Virtual-to-Destination Entertainment Model

EscapeSquid is developing relationships across the entertainment, hospitality, travel, education, and competitive-event industries. The model is designed to bring these sectors together through a year-round ecosystem connecting virtual participation with real-world entertainment and travel.

releases.title: Ric Burns' Acclaimed NEW YORK: A DOCUMENTARY FILM Returns with Two New Films September 21st and 22nd On PBS
releases.body:
Shadows of the Past and The Future of Cities explore decades of challenge, growth and change across the late 20 th and early 21 st centuries

NEW YORK, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- New York: A Documentary Film, the acclaimed series produced by Steeplechase Films and directed by Ric Burns and written by Burns and James Sanders, returns with two new films premiering Monday, September 21 and Tuesday, September 22 at 9pm on PBS (check local listings), pbs.org and the PBS App. Presenting a vivid portrait of New York's evolution and transformation over the last half-century, Shadows of the Past and The Future of Cities chronicle the story of America's largest city across more than 50 years of challenge, growth, and change. Shadows of the Past and The Future of Cities are featured as part of The WNET Group's The Story of New York collection exploring the stories and history that built New York City and the extraordinary people who continue to inspire the future of this world hub.

Shadows of the Past, explores the forces that shaped the city in the second half of the 20th century, as New York plunged into the most threatening period of decline and disorder in its history—only to rise again, thanks to a stunning drop in crime, to regain its place at the vanguard of world cities. The episode concludes in the summer of 2001, with New York, now remarkably safe and secure, unaware that a new threat from beyond its borders would soon threaten to undo all the progress of the previous decade.

The Future of Cities begins just after 9/11 and follows New York's efforts to recover under the new and untested mayoralty of Michael R. Bloomberg. Through rare archival footage and compelling interviews, the episode traces the aftermath of 9/11, the financial crisis of 2008, Superstorm Sandy in 2012 and the COVID-19 pandemic of 2020. Yet defying the doomsayers, the city also rebuilt itself in these years on a dramatic scale—economically, physically, and demographically—thanks to an astonishing influx of newcomers from around the world. The episode ends with the inauguration of Zohran Mamdani as mayor of New York in January of 2026.

Narrated by Tony Award-winning actor Robert Sean Leonard, and featuring an original score by Emmy Award-winning composer Brian Keane, Shadows of the Past and The Future of Cities are presented in high-definition 4K video and sound, and feature a combination of original cinematography, archival footage, still photography and interviews with leaders in government, academia and journalism. Featured interviewees include four former New York City mayors David Dinkins, Michael R. Bloomberg, Bill de Blasio and Eric Adams; New York-Presbyterian President (Emeritus) Dr. Steven Corwin; The New Yorker's Adam Gopnik; Columbia University Professor Kenneth Jackson; The New York Times' Wesley Morris, Michael Kimmelman and Dodai Stewart; New York magazine's Justin Davidson; Fordham University Professor Christina Greer; architect and urbanist Vishaan Chakrabarti; PBS journalist Ray Suarez; New York University Professor Suketu Mehta; and The New York Times columnist and a co-anchor of CNBC's Squawk Box Andrew Ross Sorkin; and Social Activist Claudia Romo Edelman.

"New York City has been the supreme laboratory of modern life for four hundred years now," said Burns. "It's an astonishing vortex of capitalism and democracy, innovation and change, openness and toleration, that more than any other city on earth has made itself home to all the peoples of the world. Its story over the past fifty years has been one of almost constant challenge and self-reinvention—and a testimony to the extraordinary resilience and boundless collective energies that have kept it at the forefront of world culture. We're thrilled to welcome viewers back for these amazing recent chapters in the city's history." 

"It has been a gratifying experience to bring our series up to the present day with these new episodes," said Sanders, the Emmy Award-winning co-writer and co-producer of the new films. "Not only are there so many compelling stories to tell about the city's last half-century—some surprisingly little-known—but many of the greatest themes of the original eight episodes—immigration, globalization, the city's astonishing capacity for economic and physical reinvention—have powerfully reasserted themselves in recent decades—often at a scale and with a force never before seen, even in the city's long history."   

The original eight-part, 17½-hour series—tracing the history of the city across four hundred years, since its founding by the Dutch in 1624—was the recipient of two Emmy Awards, four additional Emmy nominations, the CINE Golden Eagle, and the Alfred I. duPont-Columbia University award, and became one of the most-watched presentations in public television history. A revised edition of the series' bestselling companion volume, New York: An Illustrated History, published by Alfred A. Knopf, features two new chapters corresponding to the new episodes, along with contributions by Adam Gopnik, Ester Fuchs, and Suketu Mehta, all of whom appear in these new films. 

A production of Steeplechase Films, Inc. in association with The WNET Group for PBS, in association with Lismore Road and Artemis Rising Foundation, New York: A Documentary Film – Shadows of the Past and The Future of Cities are directed by Ric Burns, written by James Sanders and Ric Burns, and produced by Leigh Howell, Bonnie Lafave and James Sanders. Executive Producers are John Moore, Margaret Munzer Loeb, Geralyn White Dreyfous, Jana Edelbaum and Regina K. Scully. The films are narrated by Robert Sean Leonard, edited by Parker Dixon (with Chih Hsuan Liang, Omry Maoz, Margaret Metzger, Tom Patterson, Joshua Woltermann, Michael Craft and Li-Shin Yu), with cinematography by Buddy Squires ASC and music by Brian Keane. For The WNET Group, Stephen Segaller is executive in charge and Benjamin Phelps is senior producer. The films are part of the New York: A Documentary Film series originally developed with American Experience/GBH.

Corporate funding for New York: A Documentary Film – Shadows of the Past and The Future of Cities was provided by Hudson River Trading. Major funding was provided by the American Express Foundation, Simons Foundation, The Rosalind P. Walter Foundation, Google.org through the Tides Foundation, the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation, the Estate of Roland Karlen, Elaine and W. Weldon Wilson, and The Rockefeller Foundation. Support was also provided by Angela and Robert Kissane, the Ford Foundation / JustFilms, Roger and Susan Hertog, the Henry Luce Foundation, the Carson Family Charitable Trust, The Overbrook Foundation, Arthur G. Altshul, Jr. and Rula Jebreal, and by the following individuals and institutions: Fiona and Eric Rudin, Agnes Gund, Howard Morgan, The Burton P. & Judith B. Resnick Foundation, Anheuser-Busch InBev, Mr. & Mrs. Peter L. Malkin, Leon and Toby Cooperman, The Schwartz Family Foundation, Jessica & Jerry Seinfeld, the May and Samuel Rudin Family Foundation, The Walentas Family Foundation, the Gorman Family, Richard K. DeScherer, Nathalie Kaplan & David Einhorn, Marcie Pantzer, Susie Lopez, Ellin & Ron Delsener, Amy Cappellazzo & Joanne Rosen, Wendy Chaikin, Jonathan Haidt & Jayne Riew, and by public television viewers.

The WNET Group creates inspiring media content and meaningful experiences for diverse audiences nationwide. It is the community-supported home of New York's THIRTEEN – America's flagship PBS station – WLIW, THIRTEEN PBS KIDS, THIRTEEN WORLD and WLIW Create; Long Island's only NPR station WLIW-FM; ALL ARTS, the arts and culture media provider; newsroom NJ Spotlight News; and FAST channel PBS Nature. Through these channels and streaming platforms, The WNET Group brings arts, culture, education, news, documentary, entertainment, and DIY programming to more than five million viewers each month. The WNET Group's award-winning productions include signature PBS series Nature, Great Performances, American Masters, and Amanpour and Company and trusted local news programs like NJ Spotlight News with Briana Vannozzi. Inspiring curiosity and nurturing dreams, The WNET Group's award-winning Kids' Media and Education team produces the PBS KIDS series Cyberchase, interactive Mission US history games, and resources for families, teachers and caregivers. A leading nonprofit public media producer for more than 60 years, The WNET Group presents and distributes content that fosters lifelong learning, including initiatives addressing poverty, jobs, economic opportunity, social justice, understanding, and the environment. Through Passport, station members can stream new and archival programming anytime, anywhere. The WNET Group represents the best in public media. Join us.

New system pairs AI-driven strategy with human oversight, giving contractors, clinics, auto shops and med spas a marketing partner that remembers their business and compounds results over time

ST. LOUIS, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Agile & Co, a full-service marketing agency specializing in local service businesses, today announced the launch of Core, a proprietary AI-powered marketing platform. Built on an 80% AI, 20% human strategy model, Core is designed to help contractors, clinics, auto shops, med spas and other local service businesses generate more booked jobs without their marketing strategy starting from scratch every month. More information on Core is available at agileandco.com.

Core connects directly to a business's operational data, including services, pricing, and past campaign performance, and applies that context across advertising, SEO, and website work. According to Agile & Co, this removes the need for clients to repeatedly re-explain their business to a rotating cast of marketers, since Core retains that context across every campaign.

Each new campaign also feeds Core's models directly. The system analyzes lead and conversion data and adjusts strategy automatically, a design intended to help marketing performance compound over time rather than reset with every new push.

"We built Core because we were tired of watching service businesses get sold black-box AI tools that don't know their market. Core learns your business, your customers, and what actually converts, so every dollar you spend gets smarter over time instead of starting from zero," said Chans, Founder and CEO of Agile & Co.

Despite the AI foundation, Agile & Co said human strategists review every campaign and write final copy before anything goes live. The company built Core using MCP architecture, RAG retrieval, and vector databases rather than off-the-shelf AI tools, and applies it across SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and website design. Agile & Co also offers transparent, attribution-based reporting, tracking leads to their source and optimizing toward booked jobs rather than clicks, and operates without long-term client contracts.

About Agile & Co

Founded in 2012, Agile & Co has grown from a scrappy SEO shop into a full-service growth partner powered by proprietary AI. The mission never changed: do right by the businesses that trust us, even when it's the harder path.

releases.title: 2025 NFL Season Marked a Historic Step Forward for Sony + NFL Partnership with Capture of 130,000 Images by The AP, 1,100+ Hours of Broadcast Television, Deployment of 2,300+ Coach's Headsets, and Collaboration on 600+ Officiating Events
releases.body:
Building on more than a decade of partnership, Sony + NFL are moving into the 2026 Season maintaining focus on advancing the game and laying a strong foundation for future innovation

SAN DIEGO, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Sony Electronics Inc. and the National Football League (NFL) today shared an update summarizing the measurable impact Sony's technologies have had across many of NFL's most critical gameday operations and communications.

During the 2025 season, Sony's broadcast cameras captured over 1,100 hours of NFL action across over 300 games, while Sony's Alpha™ lineup of interchangeable lens cameras enabled The Associated Press to capture more than 130,000 images. The 2025 season marked a historic milestone as the first full season of Sony's Hawk-Eye video replay and measurement technologies and Sony NFL Coach's Headsets, supporting 630 officiating events and more than 2,300 Coach's Headsets used by all 32 NFL teams with zero hardware failures over the entire season. Sony and the NFL will continue innovating to further enhance game operations and shape the future of football.

Seeing the Game Like Never Before 

Sony imaging technologies help bring every NFL game to fans around the world. From live game coverage and replay to sideline photography and in-venue production, Sony's professional cameras, accessories, and imaging solutions provide broadcasters with the speed, clarity, and reliability needed to capture football's biggest moments.

Throughout the 2025 season, Sony imaging technologies supported the league's more than 1,100 hours of live game broadcasts across its major broadcast partners. Hundreds of Sony cameras and imaging solutions support broadcast production across every NFL game, with more than 175 Sony cameras deployed on and around the field during Super Bowl LX alone. Sony's high frame rate (HFR) cameras captured detailed slow-motion replays that brought fans even closer to the action.

Beyond the broadcast, Sony's continued partnership with The Associated Press enabled their team of sports photojournalists to utilize the most advanced Alpha™ camera and lens technologies, capturing over 130,000 memorable images throughout the season. 

Sony's Beyond Sports innovations are helping drive fan engagement in entirely new ways by transforming real-time tracking data from Sony's Hawk-Eye Innovations and the NFL's Next Gen Stats powered by AWS into an immersive, animated viewing experience. During the 2025 season, its technology powered Monsters Funday Football, ESPN and Disney's animated Monday Night Football alternate broadcast, contributing to ESPN's highest Monday Night Football Week 14 audience ever in the ESPN era of the iconic franchise. These alternate broadcasts create new ways for broadcasters to tell the story of the game while engaging fans and reaching new audiences.

A Faster, More Precise Game Experience

Sony's Hawk-Eye virtual measurement system has quickly become an integral part of NFL officiating, helping officials make first down measurements faster. Available across all NFL games, including preseason, regular season and postseason matchups, Sony's Hawk-Eye technology supported 21 virtual measurements, completing each measurement in nearly half the average time as the traditional chain measurement.

This included several high-profile measurement situations, including two critical measurements during the Buffalo vs. Jacksonville playoff game, confirming first downs by margins of just two and four inches, respectively.

Sony's Hawk-Eye technology also supports replay operations by providing officials and fans with additional camera angles and real-time visual data throughout the game. During the 2025 season, 360 Hawk-Eye boundary line cameras were installed across every NFL stadium (12 in each), including international venues, supporting 322 replay reviews and 141 replay assists. This provided officials with additional visual perspectives while helping broadcasters and fans better understand critical plays.

"Our partnership with Sony is rooted in a shared commitment to strengthening the game through innovation," said Tracie Rodburg, Senior Vice President of Global Partnerships at the NFL. "From officiating and coaching communications to game operations, Sony's technologies have delivered meaningful results and helped us provide a more consistent experience for officials, coaches, players and fans. As we look ahead, we're excited to continue building on that success together." 

"For more than a decade, we've worked alongside the NFL to develop technologies that solve real challenges and support some of the most important moments in the game," said Theresa Alesso, President, Imaging Products and Solutions Americas, Sony Electronics. "The results from the first season reflect what's possible when innovation is built in collaboration with the people who use it. We're excited to continue evolving that partnership and exploring what's next together."

Enabling Clear Communication Across the Sideline

Sony's NFL Coach's Headsets completed their first full season supporting all 32 NFL teams, delivering industry-leading noise cancellation for clear communication in some of the loudest environments in professional sports. With more than 2,300 headsets deployed across the league and more than 1,100 hours of gameday communication without a single hardware failure, the system provided coaches with the reliability, comfort, and clarity they need to make decisions throughout every game while supporting consistent game operations across the league.

"Sideline communication is one of the most critical parts of gameday operations, and Sony's NFL Coach's Headsets have exceeded our expectations in their first season," said Kimberly Fields, Senior Vice President of Football Business & Innovation Strategy at the NFL. "The technology has delivered the reliability, clarity, and consistency our coaches need, and we're excited to continue evolving the partnership."

Looking Ahead

From next-generation broadcast cameras to state-of-the-art optical tracking technologies, Sony innovations are helping create new viewing angles, deliver richer in-stadium experiences and provide officials and broadcasters with more powerful tools than ever before.

New broadcast technologies, including Sony's AI-enabled Pant-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) cameras, are expanding creative production possibilities by capturing unique perspectives from locations that were previously difficult to access while maintaining seamless color matching with Sony's system cameras. Across stadiums, Sony imaging technologies are also supporting new in-venue experiences, from producing highlight reels for videoboards to providing officials and teams with additional replay perspectives.

At the same time, Sony and the NFL continue to evolve Sony's Hawk-Eye tracking technologies to further enhance officiating and game administration. Planned advancements include expanded use of SkeleTRACK data and increased automation within the virtual measurement workflow to streamline operations, reduce manual inputs, expedite turnaround times and further improve the precision and consistency of virtual measurements, while continuing to evaluate future innovations such as ball spotting.

As the partnership continues to evolve, Sony and the NFL remain committed to continuing to innovate together, further build on this momentum, and help shape the future of football.

About Sony Electronics Inc.

Sony Electronics is a subsidiary of Sony Corporation of America and an affiliate of Sony Group Corporation, one of the most comprehensive entertainment companies in the world, with a portfolio that encompasses electronics, music, motion pictures, mobile, gaming, robotics and financial services. Headquartered in San Diego, California, Sony Electronics is a leader in electronics for the consumer and professional markets. Operations include research and development, engineering, sales, marketing, distribution and customer service. Sony Electronics creates products that innovate and inspire generations, such as the award-winning Alpha Interchangeable Lens Cameras and revolutionary high-resolution audio products. Sony is also a leading manufacturer of end-to-end solutions from 4K professional broadcast and A/V equipment to industry leading 4K and 8K Ultra HD TVs.

releases.title: FOX NEWS MEDIA TO PRESENT SPECIAL MULTIPLATFORM PROGRAMMING COMMEMORATING THE 25TH ANNIVERSARY OF SEPTEMBER 11TH
releases.body:
NEW YORK, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FOX News Media will honor the 25th anniversary of the September 11th, 2001 terrorist attacks with extensive multiplatform special programming. On Friday, September 11th and in the days leading up to it, network personalities and correspondents will present commemorative packages and interviews while reporting live from locations across New York, Pennsylvania and Washington, D.C.

During the week of September 7th, FOX News Channel's (FNC) signature morning show FOX & Friends (6-9 AM/ET) will broadcast live from several locations and feature interviews with guests about their experiences 25 years ago. Starting on Monday, co-host Steve Doocy, who was broadcasting live alongside co-host Brian Kilmeade on the morning of the attacks, will host the program's flagship "Breakfast with Friends" series live from the historic O'Hara's Pub in downtown Manhattan just two blocks from Ground Zero. Doocy will travel to Washington, D.C. on Tuesday and speak with Tunnels to Towers Foundation chairman and CEO Frank Siller, as the Steel Across America tour, a historic coast-to-coast campaign honoring those who sacrificed their lives on 9/11, arrives at the White House. Throughout the show on Thursday, Doocy will broadcast live from Shanksville, Pennsylvania, the crash site of United Airlines Flight 93. 

On Friday, September 11th, special coverage will commence with FOX & Friends co-hosts Kilmeade, Ainsley Earhardt and Lawrence Jones broadcasting live from the Hyatt House in Jersey City, overlooking the New York City (NYC) skyline, while Doocy will contribute live from Ground Zero. America's Newsroom (9-11 AM/ET) co-anchors Bill Hemmer and Dana Perino will broadcast live from Brookfield Place overlooking the World Trade Center campus in downtown Manhattan. The program will carry the live reading of the victims' names from the National September 11 Memorial & Museum. From 11 AM - 3 PM/ET, The Faulkner Focus (11-12 PM/ET), Outnumbered (12-1 PM/ET), and America Reports (1-3 PM/ET) will all feature special segments and interviews with a wide range of guests including families of 9/11 victims, military officials, 9/11 survivors, and founders/CEOs of 9/11-related foundations. Martha MacCallum, host of The Story (3-4 PM/ET), will report live from the Hyatt House and feature interviews with Cardinal Timothy Dolan, the New York Police Department (NYPD) co-chief chaplain, and Jessica Tisch, the NYPD Commissioner. Additionally, The Will Cain Show (4-5 PM/ET) will honor the anniversary with guests who will recount their experiences on 9/11.

Contributing to coverage throughout the day will be FNC senior correspondent Eric Shawn, who reported from Ground Zero on the day of the attacks, live from downtown Manhattan and correspondent Alexis McAdams from Shanksville. Chief national security correspondent Jennifer Griffin and senior White House correspondent Peter Doocy will report from the Pentagon and the White House, respectively. 

FOX Nation will debut two new specials exploring the impacts of the 9/11 attacks 25 years later. Premiering on September 4th, Paul Mauro's Notes from Ground Zero spotlights FNC contributor and former NYPD Inspector Paul Mauro – who was working the morning of 9/11 – as he returns to Ground Zero for the first time in 25 years. Mauro, who scribbled down notes in the days following the attacks, reunites with fellow officers and shares never-before-seen photos and video. On September 8th, FOX Nation will launch Born on 9/11: 25 Years with Harris Faulkner, exploring the lives of people born on September 11th, 2001, the hope they brought to the country, and where they are now. The platform will also livestream the official ceremonies at the NYC memorial site and the Pentagon on September 11th. 

FOX Business Network's (FBN) Liz Claman, anchor of The Claman Countdown (weekdays 3-4 PM/ET), will speak exclusively with Brandon and Kyle Lutnick, the Chairman and Executive Vice Chairman of Cantor Fitzgerald, on September 10th to commemorate the 658 Cantor Fitzgerald employees lost in the 9/11 attacks and to preview the firm's annual BGC Charity Day. On September 11th, Claman will feature an interview with founder and CEO of Silverstein Properties Larry Silverstein from the World Trade Center, which he helped rebuild following the 9/11 attacks. She will also speak with then-U.S. Senator and former New Jersey Governor Jon Corzine (D-NJ), and former JP Morgan Chase CEO Bill Harrison as they reflect on the impact of the day. 

FOX News Digital will provide day-of coverage of the commemorations at Ground Zero, the Pentagon and Shanksville, including live updates, coordinated video and social content and live stream embeds from all three ceremonies. The platform will feature interviews with Elizabeth L. Hillman, president and CEO of the National September 11 Memorial & Museum, and former Navy SEAL Robert O'Neill, who participated in the 2011 raid that killed Osama bin Laden. Throughout the day, FOX News Digital will publish multiple retrospective and feature stories focused on survivors, first responders, victims' families and those carrying the legacy of 9/11 forward 25 years later. The platform will also offer political and policy coverage, including reporting on how homeland security has evolved since the attacks. Additionally, the platform will publish a "Never Forget" archival photo retrospective, including a look at how Ground Zero and the lower Manhattan skyline have changed since the attacks. 

FOX News Audio will present extensive coverage of the anniversary. Throughout the day on September 11th, FOX News Headlines 24/7 on Sirius XM will provide the latest updates on ceremonies and events every 15 minutes. Leading up to the commemoration, FOX News Radio (FNR) will share two weeks of daily one-minute feature reports, each spotlighting someone personally affected by the 9/11 attacks. FNR will also offer breaking news coverage of the NYC memorial ceremony, featuring reporting from Ground Zero. The Brian Kilmeade Show, Fox Across America with Jimmy Failla and The Guy Benson Show will interview guests and newsmakers impacted by the attacks. On YouTube, The Brian Kilmeade Show will provide access to some of Kilmeade's most notable 9/11 interviews, and FNR affiliates will be offered an anniversary special from Kilmeade that reflects on how America has evolved since then.

FOX News Podcasts will release specialized coverage in remembrance as well. The FOX News Rundown podcast will mark the anniversary by delivering a week of immersive content across its platform. The FOX News Rundown: Evening Edition will anchor the programming by providing personal accounts of survival and exploring the lasting geopolitical and cultural impacts of the attacks. The FOX Business Rundown and FOX News From Washington will examine the quarter-century legacy through dedicated economic, policy, and national security lenses. On Perino on Politics, Perino will sit down with key insiders of the Bush administration who helped navigate the crisis from the center of power, including Chief Photographer Eric Draper, Presidential Speechwriter John McConnell and Director of Media Affairs Jeanie Mamo. Additionally, the host of Searching for Heroes, FNC's Benjamin Hall, will sit down with guests whose lives were impacted by the attacks, sharing stories of survival, sacrifice and resilience. Finally, FOX News Podcasts has launched an eight-part documentary series entitled FOX News Rewind: 9/11, building upon previous coverage, this updated edition features new reporting, examining the events leading up to the attacks, the courage of those who survived and responded, as well as the aftermath. The series will feature commentators such as Brit Hume, Steve Doocy, and Kilmeade. Bill Hemmer will host the finale of the series from the National September 11 Memorial & Museum where he will be joined by Elizabeth L. Hillman and other guests for a forward-looking dialogue on memory, endurance, and legacy.

releases.body:
MIAMI, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ViendoMovies, the Spanish–language PayTV channel owned by SOMOSTV (a company chaired by Luis Villanueva and part of SOMOS Group), which programs the best contemporary films produced in Spanish, 24 hours a day and without commercial interruptions, celebrates during the month of September 2026 the twentieth (20th) anniversary of a space that showcases and promotes the cinema that has impacted audiences around the world. ViendoMovies commemorates an outstanding trajectory in Spanish–language television in the United States and Puerto Rico presenting modern and exclusive films, originally produced in Spanish, with high production values, big–screen quality, and the most popular talent from all Spanish–speaking countries. The channel is included in the Hispanic channel packages of major cable and telecommunications companies, strengthening entertainment offerings for the Latino community.

ViendoMovies was launched on September 5, 2006, with a premium profile, elegant on–air presence, and a high–quality graphic package. The channel programs films in High Definition and first–window PayTV releases, not available on other channels or platforms—an important option in times of redundancy in title distribution. With its extensive library, the channel offers, in addition to regular premieres, genre or talent cycles, functioning as a promotional space for modern Spanish–language cinema.

ViendoMovies includes closed captioning in English and Spanish and coverage of events where Spanish–language cinema participates, such as the Oscars, Goya Awards, Ariel Awards, and festivals in Huelva, San Sebastián, Miami, Chicago, and others. The channel includes a significant offering of Video On Demand (VOD) titles, allowing subscribers to enjoy great films whenever they choose.

Before the arrival of ViendoMovies, Spanish–language cinema had limited representation in the market, despite the production capacity of countries with well–developed film industries such as Colombia, Chile, Peru, the Dominican Republic, Argentina, and Spain, among others. The cinema from these countries on the channel, combined with the significant presence of Mexican cinema (for the largest Latino community), provides a balanced offering of origins and genres and represents an important source of revenue for the Spanish–language film industry, supporting its growth and sustainability.

ViendoMovies celebrates national holidays and U.S. festivities, fostering integration and meeting the needs of a community that goes to the movies an average of 3.3 times a year—compared to Asians (2.9) and Whites (2.3)—and represents 24% of box office sales despite being 19% of the population.

Luis Villanueva, President and CEO of SOMOS Group, stated: "Twenty years in such a competitive and dynamic market is an achievement worthy of celebration. Our team established a position that is a source of pride for us, our clients, and our audience. We deliver a channel of the highest quality, competitive with the best, in the most developed television market. Cinema is one of the entertainment options most preferred by Latinos, and with ViendoMovies we enjoy modern productions representative of a cutting–edge industry. We will continue this important mission, which connects us with our roots and language."

ViendoMovies celebrates more than an anniversary. These are 20 years of permanence, evolution, and connection with its audience as a destination to enjoy the best films originally produced in Spanish. The channel also celebrates Hispanic Heritage Month, from September 15 to October 15, along with the celebration of Mexico's Independence Day (September 16), featuring productions from that country throughout the day.

ABOUT VIENDOMOVIES: ViendoMovies is a premium Spanish–language PayTV channel programming exclusive contemporary cinema in Spanish, without commercial interruptions, 24 hours a day, in a culturally relevant premium package. ViendoMovies is produced for the Hispanic market in the United States and Puerto Rico and is part of SOMOSTV LLC. For more information, visit http://www.viendomovies.com and https://www.somostv.com

NEW YORK, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Entrepreneur, winery owner, winemaker and filmmaker Eunice Chiweshe Goldstein, today announced the expansion of her entrepreneurial portfolio, bringing together ventures across wine, film and emerging technology as she enters the next phase of her career.
releases.title: Entrepreneur and Filmmaker Eunice Chiweshe Goldstein Expands Business Portfolio Across Wine, Film and Emerging Technology
releases.body:
Winery owner, winemaker and filmmaker enters a new chapter of entrepreneurship spanning consumer brands, socially driven filmmaking and artificial intelligence

NEW YORK, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Entrepreneur, winery owner, winemaker and filmmaker Eunice Chiweshe Goldstein, today announced the expansion of her entrepreneurial portfolio, bringing together ventures across wine, film and emerging technology as she enters the next phase of her career.

Chiweshe Goldstein, whose work has crossed entrepreneurship and storytelling, is developing a broader portfolio built around three areas: the continued growth of her wine business, the advancement of film, television and documentary projects, and the development of a new artificial intelligence venture addressing emerging challenges surrounding it.

Rather than viewing the three industries as separate careers, Chiweshe Goldstein sees them as interconnected parts of a larger strategy centered on ownership, intellectual property and the creation of enduring brands.

"A person does not have to remain inside the category where the world first discovers them," said Chiweshe Goldstein. "Film taught me the extraordinary power of storytelling. Wine taught me how to build a physical product and a brand. Technology creates an opportunity to build at tremendous scale. I see all three as different expressions of the same entrepreneurial instinct."

Building a Brand Through Wine

Chiweshe Goldstein's entrepreneurial journey includes building the Eunice Chiweshe Goldstein Winery, an independent wine business through which she has combined winemaking, entrepreneurship and storytelling.

Her Zimbabwean heritage has informed her perspective as an entrepreneur building within the American wine industry.

For Chiweshe Goldstein, developing a winery has required far more than producing wine. It has meant navigating the realities of building an independent consumer business, including production, compliance, distribution, marketing, branding and customer acquisition.

Those experiences helped shape a broader philosophy that Chiweshe Goldstein is now applying across other industries.

"Building a company teaches you that an idea is the beginning," Chiweshe Goldstein said. "You have to create the product, survive the journey and keep executing when nobody else can see the entire picture."

Film With a Purpose

Alongside her entrepreneurial work, Chiweshe Goldstein has continued developing projects as a filmmaker and producer.

Her film interests include narrative and documentary projects examining consequential social issues through deeply personal stories.

Among her projects in development is documentary work examining lead exposure in America's water systems and its impact on families and children.

Chiweshe Goldstein's approach emphasizes human storytelling rather than treating large social issues simply as statistics or policy discussions.

"The issues that affect millions of people ultimately happen to individuals," Chiweshe Goldstein said. "Film gives us the ability to take something enormous and allow an audience to experience it through another person's life."

Eunice Chiweshe Goldstein Studios is building a robust slate of original television and feature film projects as it expands its development and production activities. The studio is advancing several projects through development, including an original television sitcom now entering the casting process as it moves toward production.

Entering Artificial Intelligence

Chiweshe Goldstein is now extending that entrepreneurial philosophy into technology.

She is developing an artificial intelligence venture focused on challenges surrounding AI adoption through Chiweshe Artificial Intelligence / Chiweshe Group.

The venture is exploring opportunities to help organizations navigate an environment in which artificial intelligence is becoming increasingly embedded in business operations and decision making.

Chiweshe Goldstein believes the rapid advancement of AI will create significant opportunities not merely for companies developing increasingly capable artificial intelligence, but also for businesses developing the infrastructure necessary to support its responsible use.

"As AI becomes more powerful, trust becomes increasingly important," Chiweshe Goldstein said. "The next generation of technology will not merely be about what artificial intelligence can do. It will also be about creating confidence around how businesses use it."

Specific details regarding the venture's technology, methodology and product development remain confidential during development.

A Portfolio Built Around Ownership

The expansion reflects Chiweshe Goldstein's larger vision of becoming a portfolio entrepreneur rather than being defined by a single industry.

The strategy places particular emphasis on intellectual property and ownership.

Wine provides a consumer product and brand.

Film creates stories and intellectual property capable of reaching audiences globally.

Technology creates opportunities for significant scale.

Together, Chiweshe Goldstein sees the three areas as the foundation of a long-term entrepreneurial portfolio.

"The common denominator for me is growth and ownership," Chiweshe Goldstein said. "Ownership of ideas, ownership of intellectual property and ownership of the businesses we create. I want to build things that can keep growing long after the original idea."

Chiweshe Goldstein plans to keep developing her wine and film businesses while advancing the artificial intelligence venture during the next phase of her entrepreneurial career.

The expansion represents an evolution.

Eunice Chiweshe Goldstein said, "I want to keep building, keep creating and keep entering spaces where I believe something meaningful can be made."

About Eunice Chiweshe Goldstein

Eunice Chiweshe Goldstein is an entrepreneur, winery owner, winemaker, filmmaker and producer whose work spans wine, entertainment and emerging technology. Through her entrepreneurial and creative ventures, Chiweshe Goldstein focuses on building independent brands, developing original intellectual property and pursuing projects at the intersection of business, culture and social impact.

Her current work includes the continued development of the Eunice Chiweshe Goldstein Winery, film, television and documentary projects, and an emerging artificial intelligence venture.

SHENZHEN, China, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hollyland, a leading provider of wireless products for professional film and video production, and content creation, today announced the Pyro 7 Ultra, a professional all-in-one 7-inch wireless monitor that integrates robust wireless connectivity and professional-grade monitoring into a single, highly portable device. Built for cinematographers, directors, camera operators, DITs, and focus pullers, the Pyro 7 Ultra delivers broadcast-grade color accuracy alongside robust, long-range, and low-latency wireless video transmission. It simplifies camera-top monitoring, wireless focus pulling, and mobile director monitoring, reducing setup complexity and enabling a more efficient production workflow.

Jay Sun, Product Manager at Hollyland stated, "For professional productions, an accurate monitor is essential because every department needs a reliable visual reference on set. Even minor color differences can affect decisions and create problems later in post-production. With Pyro 7 Ultra's QD-LCD technology, crews can trust what they see during production with professional-grade color accuracy".

Pre-Calibrated Display with Broadcast-Grade Color Accuracy

At the heart of the Pyro 7 Ultra is a premium QD-LCD display that delivers broadcast-grade color quality and consistency required for professional productions.

Each monitor is Calman® pre-calibrated to achieve a ΔE <1.5, ensuring highly accurate color reproduction directly out of the box. The display offers 99% Rec.709 and 95% DCI-P3 color gamut, Gamma 2.4, and up to 1,500 nits of brightness, providing dependable monitoring even in bright environments.

For long-term consistency, users can quickly recalibrate the display using the Hollyland Color Calibrator holistic solution that doesn't require a PC or third-party calibration hardware.

HDMI and SDI interfaces support loop-through and cross-output. Camera control is supported on select camera models from Sony, Canon, Nikon, and ARRI, with responsive control of functions including shutter, aperture, ISO, white balance, and more.

Robust Wireless Performance with TWiFi

Powered by Hollyland's proprietary Twin-WiFi (TWiFi) technology, the Pyro 7 Ultra simultaneously utilizes two wireless bands to create a resilient dual-path connection. Automatic frequency hopping minimizes interference in congested RF environments, maintaining a stable connection.

The system enables wireless video transmission at ranges of up to 1 km (3,300 feet), with latency as low as 20 ms in Focus Mode. It also supports 4K60 video transmission via one transmitter to an unlimited number of receivers, making it ideal for productions requiring multiple monitoring positions.

Professional Monitoring with HollyOS

The Pyro 7 Ultra introduces HollyOS, Hollyland's next-generation operating system designed for fast-paced production environments. The intuitive interface offers direct display controls, customizable monitoring layouts, and an extensive range of professional image analysis tools.

A Unified Ecosystem for Multi-Camera Productions

Unlike standalone wireless monitoring solutions, the Pyro 7 Ultra is designed as part of Hollyland's broader Pyro ecosystem. It pairs with compatible Pyro transmitters, receivers, and monitors, allowing production teams to expand or reconfigure wireless monitoring workflows without interoperability concerns or production delays. The result is a reliable, flexible, and scalable system that adapts easily to productions of any size.

Pricing and Availability

The Hollyland Pyro 7 Ultra is available now through authorized Hollyland distributors, Amazon, and the Hollyland online store for $1,399 USD.

For more information, visit: https://www.hollyland.com/product/pyro-7-ultra

About Hollyland

Hollyland is a leading provider of wireless products specializing in wireless intercom systems, video transmission systems, monitors, wireless microphones, and live streaming cameras. Since 2013, Hollyland has served millions of users worldwide across filmmaking, broadcasting, video production, live events, theaters, houses of worship, exhibitions, and content creation. The company operates a global sales network spanning approximately 160 countries and regions, supported by regional teams and offices worldwide. For more information, please visit https://www.hollyland.com/, Hollyland Facebook, and Hollyland Instagram.

releases.title: Cambium launches ApexFrame 5000, a high-temperature laminating film adhesive for demanding bonding applications
releases.body:
EL SEGUNDO, Calif., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cambium, developer of advanced composites and specialty materials, today announced the launch of ApexFrame™ 5000, a phthalonitrile-based film adhesive engineered for high-temperature, non-structural bonding of polymer films and metallic foils.

ApexFrame 5000 delivers sustained operational performance up to 600°F (315°C), with short-duration performance up to 800°F (427°C), addressing a persistent gap in high-temperature adhesive systems: materials that can survive the most demanding thermal environments without the handling burden that typically comes with them. The system is solvent-free, room-temperature stable, and requires no freezer storage, reducing both logistics complexity and total cost of ownership for manufacturers.

"A customer came to us with a challenge that existing adhesive technologies couldn't solve: bonding performance in extreme thermal environments for demanding aircraft and drone applications," said Cambium CTO James Griffin. "By combining our materials expertise with a rapid development approach, we delivered ApexFrame 5000, a high-temperature laminating adhesive built for defense applications, that helps customers meet demanding performance requirements without compromising manufacturability."

The launch reflects Cambium's core operating model: taking a material from discovery through qualified production at speed and scale. ApexFrame 5000 moves through Cambium's integrated pipeline, discovery, product development, and manufacturing, unified under a single operating system, compressing a process that traditionally takes years into a matter of months.

Cambium's manufacturing footprint gives customers a direct path from formulation to production-ready material, without the handoffs and delays that come from working across separate suppliers for chemistry, qualification, and manufacturing. That integration is increasingly critical for customers in aerospace, defense, and space, where thermal extremes, tight qualification windows, and long-term reliability are all non-negotiable.

ApexFrame 5000 is available now as an unsupported film adhesive in standard roll widths of 12 in (300mm) and 38 in (965mm), with additional widths and carrier options available upon request.

For technical specifications or to request samples, contact composites@cambiumglobal.com.

About Cambium

Cambium is building the advanced materials base for those building the future. The company integrates AI-driven materials discovery, rapid product development, industrialized qualification, and flexible manufacturing into a single operating system — compressing the path from invention to qualified production from years to months. Cambium's advanced composites and specialty materials serve customers across defense, aerospace, space, high-performance automotive and other industries where performance and speed of supply are decisive. Headquartered in El Segundo, CA, Cambium operates four manufacturing, development, and testing facilities across the US, UK, and EU. Please visit cambiumglobal.com

For more information, contact Stephan Herrera, Co-founder, Chief Marketing Officer and Head of Government Affairs at stephan.herrera@cambiumglobal.com

WTT joins USA Sports' robust portfolio of premium sports rights, which includes the WNBA, NASCAR Cup Series, Premier League, Bundesliga, WWE, the PGA Tour, LPGA Tour, Pac-12 football and basketball, LOVB (League One Volleyball), and more.

releases.body:
Kling Brothers Entertainment premiere debuted with cast, crew and community supporters to celebrate Central Florida's growing independent film community

ORLANDO, Fla., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Things I Didn't Do, the independent psychological thriller series created by filmmaker Thiago Kling, premiered Saturday, Aug. 8, at Regal Winter Park Village & RPX, welcoming a full-capacity audience for the debut of its pilot.

Presented by Kling Brothers Entertainment in collaboration with the Orlando Film Commission, the premiere brought together the series' cast, crew, filmmakers, media and community supporters for an evening celebrating the years of work behind the production.

Originally conceived in 2015, The Things I Didn't Do was ultimately brought to life in Central Florida, with local talent and production partners contributing to the project on both sides of the camera. The premiere offered an opportunity to recognize that collaborative effort while spotlighting the region's established and emerging film community.

"Having the premiere here in Orlando, surrounded by the people who helped make this project possible, was incredibly rewarding," said Thiago Kling, creator and writer of The Things I Didn't Do. "The response from the audience made the night special for the entire cast and crew. We're proud of what we created together and grateful to everyone who supported us along the way."

Directed by Fernando Tosetti, whose work has earned numerous honors, including Best Director at Campus Movie Fest (2019), Best Editing from Orlando Independent Filmmakers (2021), Best Cinematography from the Organization of Independent Filmmakers (2025), a Silver Telly Award for Videography (2026) and a Best Picture nomination at the Hollywood Florida Film Festival, the series brings together an accomplished creative team. Written by Julia Antuerpem, a former Disney, Globo and Netflix writer, Harvard-trained creative writer and author of award-winning screenplays recognized with more than 60 international honors.

The series follows Ethan, a withdrawn teenager struggling to find his place in the world. To cope with feelings of isolation, Ethan fills a secret notebook with disturbing drawings imagining the deaths of those who have hurt him. When the notebook disappears and the people inside it begin dying exactly as he imagined, Ethan is pulled into a chilling mystery that forces him to question what is real and who can be trusted.

Following its Orlando premiere, The Things I Didn't Do begins its next chapter as the filmmakers explore opportunities to continue production and bring the full series to life for new audiences.
