releases.title: Huntington Bank Names Ameesh Vakharia Chief Marketing and Digital Products Officer
releases.body:
Experienced executive will lead newly integrated marketing and digital products organization

COLUMBUS, Ohio, Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Huntington National Bank ("Huntington") today announced the appointment of Ameesh Vakharia as executive vice president and chief marketing and digital products officer.

In this newly created role, Ameesh will lead Huntington's integrated marketing and digital products organization, bringing together brand, marketing and digital product management to strengthen the Huntington brand, drive customer growth and create more connected sales and service experiences across digital and physical channels. He will report to Brant Standridge, president of consumer and regional banking. 

For more than 160 years, Huntington has evolved with its customers by investing in products, services and experiences that help people and businesses manage their financial lives. As expectations continue to change, the bank is bringing marketing and digital product teams closer to support more connected customer experiences.

"Bringing marketing and digital products together creates an opportunity to move faster, simplify how we work and create more seamless experiences for customers," said Standridge. "Ameesh has a strong track record of connecting strategy, brand, product and digital teams around the common goal of delivering differentiated value for customers. His experience will help us turn ideas into customer-focused solutions and accelerate innovation across the business."

Ameesh joins Huntington with more than two decades of leadership experience across strategy, digital, product and channel management, customer growth and brand leadership. Most recently, he served as executive vice president and chief strategy and brand officer at USAA, where he led enterprise strategy, innovation, digital, marketing, communications, corporate responsibility and membership growth efforts as a member of the company's Executive Council.

Prior to USAA, Ameesh served on the Operating Council at Truist, where he led retail deposits, small business banking, contact centers, strategy, analytics and omnichannel client experience. He also held several senior leadership positions at SunTrust spanning deposits, digital channels, customer experience and enterprise strategy.

"What attracted me to Huntington was its strong culture, commitment to customers and long history of innovating on their behalf," said Ameesh. "Customers don't distinguish between a brand promise and a product experience, and the strongest organizations shouldn't either. Bringing these capabilities together creates an opportunity to move faster, deliver more connected experiences, and make banking simpler and more personal for customers."

Ameesh's appointment follows the transition of Vijay Konduru and Mark Sheehan into newly expanded enterprise leadership roles. Konduru now serves as head of Huntington's business innovation and AI products organization, and Sheehan serves as head of the bank's digital assets organization.

"These strategic changes will help us move ideas from concept to customer impact more quickly, and build the products, capabilities and experiences that will define the future of banking at Huntington," Standridge said.

Ameesh will be based in Charlotte, North Carolina.

For more information about Huntington, visit Huntington.com.

About Huntington

Huntington Bancshares Incorporated is a $284 billion asset regional bank holding company headquartered in Columbus, Ohio. A top 10 U.S. commercial bank, The Huntington National Bank and its affiliates provide consumers, small and middle-market businesses, corporations, municipalities, and other organizations with a comprehensive suite of banking, payments, wealth management, and risk management products and services. Founded in 1866, Huntington operates over 1,400 branches in 21 states, with certain businesses operating nationally. Visit Huntington.com for more information.

NASHVILLE, Tenn., Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Unsigned Only Music Awards is proud to announce the winners of the 2026 competition, recognizing an extraordinary group of independent artists from around the world whose music stood out among thousands of entries.

This year's top honor, Artist of the Year, has been awarded to Artur Menezes for "Once Again." In addition, Unsigned Only has named winners across its diverse range of categories, celebrating outstanding talent in all genres of contemporary music.

Unlike traditional awards programs, Unsigned Only is specifically dedicated to independent and unsigned artists. Winners are selected by a panel of accomplished recording artists, music managers, booking agents, journalists, and other music-industry professionals with extensive experience in their respective fields. For a complete list of judges go to: https://www.unsignedonly.com/judges.

Each winner receives a custom award designed by Society Awards, the company behind high-profile entertainment awards including the Emmy and Golden Globe awards. The Artist of the Year also receives a $20,000 cash prize.

Many past winners of Unsigned Only have gone on to sign major label deals, tour internationally, secure licensing placements, and build successful careers, including: GAYLE, Ingrid Andress, Jordan Adetunji, Gabby Barrett, Coco Jones, Tenille Arts, Faouzia, Jordan St. Cyr, Brett Young, and many more.

Artur Menezes, the Artist of The Year recipient, is a Brazilian-born, Los Angeles-based guitarist, singer, and songwriter. Known for his explosive guitar playing, soulful vocals, and distinctive ability to blend Blues and Rock, Menezes has built an international reputation. His career has taken him from the blues clubs of Chicago to major festivals and stages across the United States, Europe, and South America. He performed at Lollapalooza Brazil 2026 as the only blues rock artist in the lineup. He has shared stages with artists including Buddy Guy, Joe Satriani, Steve Vai, and Christone "Kingfish" Ingram, among others.

Upon learning of his Unsigned Only win, Menezes said, "It's hard to put into words what I'm feeling right now, but one thing I can say is this: besides the art itself, recognition is one of the best things an artist can have. Thank you so much!"

Menezes' accomplishments already include the Blues Foundation's Gibson/Albert King Award for Best Guitarist and appearances on the Experience Hendrix Tour and Eric Clapton's Crossroads Guitar Festival. Guitar Player Magazine selected him one of the 'Top Best 25 New Blues Artists', while Joe Bonamassa singled him out as one of the most exciting modern blues guitarists "who shreds the blues and is not afraid to do that."

"Artur Menezes is the kind of artist Unsigned Only was created to recognize," said Candace Avery and Jim Morgan, founders of Unsigned Only. "His extraordinary musicianship, distinctive voice, and authenticity come through in every note – and his ability to make the guitar speak with such power and emotion is truly remarkable. You can hear the years of dedication in his playing, but you can also hear the joy, passion, and personality behind it."

In addition to Menezes, there is a winner in each of the 24 categories. Hailing from all over the world they range from talented amateurs to seasoned performers. For a complete list of winners, go to: https://www.unsignedonly.com/winners.

releases.title: CallRail Connects Healthcare Marketing to Patient Outcomes Through 15 New Integrations
releases.body:
New EHR and patient management system integrations help healthcare organizations connect marketing campaigns to appointments and new patients

ATLANTA, Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- CallRail, the AI-powered lead engagement platform, today announced new healthcare capabilities that enable practices and their marketing partners to connect marketing investments to booked appointments and patient outcomes. Healthcare marketers can now see which calls result in appointments and move beyond measuring campaign success by call volume alone.

At the center of the update is CallRail's expanded healthcare integration library, which now connects with 15 leading electronic health record and patient management systems through its NexHealth partnership, including athenahealth, Dentrix, Eaglesoft, eClinicalWorks, ModMed and Open Dental, among others. By connecting marketing data with the tools practices already use to manage patient relationships and scheduling, healthcare organizations can identify where leads originate and which campaigns ultimately drive appointments.

To make those insights easier to use, CallRail is also introducing suggested healthcare outcome tags based on the results healthcare businesses actually track. The tags help teams understand the outcome of each conversation automatically without building a tagging system from scratch or requiring front-desk staff to manually label every interaction.

By connecting lead and appointment outcomes to marketing activity, healthcare organizations and their agencies gain a more complete view of performance. That visibility provides marketers with better information to evaluate their investments and optimize campaigns around the outcomes that matter most to the practice.  These include campaigns executed through Google Ads, Performance Max and other advertising channels.

"Healthcare practices are investing more in marketing, but that investment can drive growth only when teams understand what happens after a lead reaches out," said Kara Kelly, VP of Platform Strategy at CallRail. "These capabilities connect marketing activity to the outcomes practices actually care about, while taking work off of the intake and front-desk teams."

The capabilities are available to eligible CallRail healthcare customers, with no rebuilding or data migration required. releases.title: Blubrry Brings Unified Video and Audio Podcast Publishing to Apple Podcasts
releases.body:
Blubrry Publisher customers can upload one video episode and make it available to watch or listen through a single podcast feed

COOPERSVILLE, Mich., Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Blubrry Podcasting today announced that it now works with Apple Podcasts to integrate HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) video into shows published through Blubrry Publisher.

The new workflow allows Blubrry hosting customers to upload one MP4 video episode and make it available in video and audio formats through a single RSS feed. Blubrry automatically creates an HLS video version for Apple Podcasts, retains the original video file and generates an MP3 audio version for podcast apps that do not support HLS video.

For creators, this means one upload, one episode and one feed to manage. For audiences using Apple Podcasts, it provides the flexibility to watch or listen and switch between audio and video with a tap.

"Video podcasting should give creators more ways to share their work without requiring a separate publishing process," said Barry Kantz, CEO at Blubrry Podcasting. "Blubrry Publisher customers can upload one video episode, continue managing one podcast feed and give their audience the choice to watch or listen."

A More Flexible Experience on Apple Podcasts

Video on Apple Podcasts uses HTTP Live Streaming video. HLS video divides an episode into smaller segments and prepares it at multiple quality levels.

As someone watches, Apple Podcasts can adjust the video quality based on the strength of their Wi-Fi or cellular connection. This adaptive delivery can help video begin playing faster and continue with fewer buffering interruptions as connection conditions change.

Because video and audio are connected to the same episode, audiences can switch between audio and video with a tap without searching for another version of the show.

One Upload, Three Available Formats

When a Blubrry Publisher customer uploads an MP4 video episode, Blubrry automatically prepares:

  • An HLS video version for Apple Podcasts
  • The original uploaded video file
  • An MP3 audio version for audio-focused podcast apps

All three formats are included within the same RSS feed.

Apple Podcasts uses the HLS video version. Other podcast apps can use the HLS video, original video file or MP3 audio enclosure based on the formats they support.

This removes the need to upload separate audio and video episodes or maintain parallel feeds for the same show.

Available Through Blubrry Publisher

After connecting Apple Podcasts Connect to Blubrry, customers can publish video episodes through their existing Blubrry Publisher workflow.

Blubrry automatically prepares the uploaded video as a 1080p Full HD HLS video version and creates an MP3 audio version. Some processing time is required before the episode becomes available to watch on Apple Podcasts.

The feature is currently available to Blubrry hosting customers using Blubrry Publisher. It is not available for shows published through the PowerPress podcasting plugin at this time.

PowerPress customers can continue using their current WordPress publishing workflow without making any changes.

To get started, customers must generate an API key through Apple Podcasts Connect and upload the key file within their Blubrry dashboard.

Customers can learn more at HLS at Blubrry or follow the setup instructions in Blubrry's documentation.

About Blubrry Podcasting

Blubrry Podcasting provides podcast hosting, publishing, audience statistics, monetization and distribution tools for audio and video creators. Its services include Blubrry Publisher, the PowerPress podcasting plugin for WordPress, IAB-certified podcast statistics, podcast websites and tools for independent creators, businesses and podcast networks.

releases.body:
Powerful Film Tells Little-Known Story of Largest Maritime Evacuation in History, Extraordinary Civilian Armada Carried 500,000 People to Safety

Boatlift 9/11 Named Best Short of the Season by Independent Shorts Awards

NEW YORK, Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Great American Media commemorates the 25th anniversary of September 11 with the World Television Premiere of Original Film, Boatlift 9/11 (Boatlift 9/11), the award-winning short honoring the extraordinary mariners and ordinary citizens who answered an urgent call for help as Lower Manhattan came under attack. The film streams exclusively on Great American Pure Flix, beginning September 10.

Boatlift 9/11 honors the mariners who helped carry 500,000 to safety. Streaming Sept. 10 on Great American Pure Flix.

Twenty-five years after September 11, 2001, much of America knows the images and stories that have come to define that terrible day. Less widely known is what happened along the waterfront. As transportation out of Lower Manhattan shut down and thousands of people reached the water with nowhere else to go, ferries, tugboats, fishing boats and private vessels began moving toward them. More than 100 vessels ultimately joined the effort helping evacuate approximately 500,000 people in what became the largest maritime evacuation in history.

Inspired by Jessica DuLong's Saved at the Seawall, Boatlift 9/11 tells that history through Captain Jan and her daughter Britt, who are aboard their tugboat in New York Harbor when the first planes strike the World Trade Center. They race toward Battery Park, where survivors are stranded along the seawall. Their tug was never meant to carry crowds, but the pair begins pulling people aboard as smoke and ash consumed the waterfront. When Britt is swept into the river while trying to save another passenger, Jan faces an agonizing choice between searching for her daughter and getting those already aboard to safety. Jan and Britt eventually reunite and turn back toward Manhattan as the call goes out for "all available boats."

"I was in my office in New York, looking right down Sixth Avenue at an unimaginable tragedy as the second plane flew into the South Tower of the World Trade Center on September 11," said Bill Abbott, President & CEO, Great American Media. "Twenty-five years later, what remains equally vivid is what Americans did next. People ran toward the Towers to help people they did not know. Boatlift 9/11 tells one of the remarkable stories from that day, when hundreds of thousands of people found a way out of New York's lower west side because others chose to come for them, by boat. It is a story we are honored to be a part of producing and presenting on our platforms," Abbott concluded.

The film stars internationally acclaimed Swedish actress Sofia Helin (The Bridge, Atlantic Crossing) as Jan, with Preslea Elliott (Killers of the Flower Moon) as Britt and Hank Northrop ("Days of Our Lives," "Criminal Minds") as Eric. The film is directed by Dale Fabrigar. Written by Tricia Aurand. Produced by Suzanne DeLaurentiis, Nathan Samdahl, Dale Fabrigar, Nicole Menendez, David Courtice, and Christopher Dukes.

For producer Suzanne DeLaurentiis, Boatlift 9/11 is both a work of historical remembrance and an effort to preserve a part of September 11 history that many Americans have never known. An award-winning producer, writer and director whose career spans more than 100 film and television productions, DeLaurentiis has also long supported members of the military through her Operation Hollywood program, which helps veterans pursue careers in entertainment. She has received two U.S. military Commendation Medals for the work.

"Twenty-five years is an important threshold," said Suzanne DeLaurentiis. "There is now a generation of Americans who did not experience September 11 firsthand, and the responsibility to preserve these stories becomes greater with time. I wanted Boatlift 9/11 to remember the people who saw strangers in desperate need and simply went to get them. Half a million people made it off Manhattan by water that day. That extraordinary act of humanity deserves its place in our national memory," DeLaurentiis concluded.

Boatlift 9/11 has already received significant festival recognition. The Independent Shorts Awards International Film Festival named the film Best Short of the Season for June–July 2026. The film advanced to the festival's 2026 Annual Awards with nominations for Best Drama Short, Best Male Director for Dale Fabrigar, Best Supporting Actress for Preslea Elliott, Best Editing for Radu Ion and Best Original Score for Oliver Goodwill. The Annual Awards showcase will take place on September 19 at Regal LA Live in Los Angeles.

The film is presented by Suzanne DeLaurentiis Productions and the Mendez National Institute of Transplantation Foundation. Its commemoration of the boatlift also calls attention to the lasting health consequences experienced by people exposed to toxic debris following the attacks and the continuing need to support September 11 survivors. For more information on Kidney awareness and the Mendez National Institute of Transplantation Foundation visit MNITF.org.

Great American Media is the leader in faith and family entertainment, and one of the fastest-growing entertainment networks on television. Great American Media is home to a portfolio of entertainment brands that celebrate faith, family, and country, including Great American Family, the flagship linear network featuring original Christmas movies, rom-coms, and beloved series; Great American Pure Flix, the leading faith and family streaming service; Great American Faith & Living, the unscripted companion network; and GFam+, an app that lets viewers watch anytime, anywhere. releases.body:
• Building on CTS' VideoAI™ platform, new suite of end-to-end AI-powered workflow applications brings premium content processing capabilities to manage and monetize entire content libraries



  • Applications include video verticalization, localization, smart chapters, metadata enrichment, quality control, and intelligent clip generation



  • Designed to work across CTS' portfolio, including Comcast Media360™, Comcast Sports360™, and standalone Cloud Video Platform deployments

DENVER, Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- In advance of the 2026 IBC Show, Comcast Technology Solutions (CTS) today unveiled a comprehensive suite of end-to-end AI-powered workflow applications for broadcasters, content owners, and operators worldwide. Building on the foundation of CTS' VideoAI™ platform, these new applications deliver AI as practical, integrated solutions to real-world content production and management challenges.

In a market increasingly crowded with standalone AI vendors and start-ups, CTS aims to serve as a single, trusted partner for end-to-end AI-enhanced content processing, video management, and monetization — backed by the proven reliability and scale of Comcast Technology Solutions and 24/7 managed services. CTS provides end-to-end, production-ready workflow integration that embeds AI capabilities into complete, deployable applications — requiring no additional specialist AI knowledge or developer requirements. The new applications are designed to work across CTS' full product portfolio, including Comcast Media360™ for broadcasters and content owners, Comcast Sports360™ for sports rights holders, and standalone deployments of CTS' Cloud Video Platform (CVP) for operators.

"The video industry is ready to move past AI hypotheticals and onto production-ready applications that solve real problems, generate new business opportunities, and integrate seamlessly into the workflows they already rely upon," said Bart Spriester, Senior Vice President and General Manager of Streaming, Broadcast, and Advertising at Comcast Technology Solutions. "Whether for creating vertical videos, localization, advanced advertising, metadata enrichment, quality control, or intelligent clip generation, CTS stands ready to help our customers benefit from AI to better manage and monetize their content catalogs. CTS VideoAI is based on implementations deployed by some of the world's largest media companies, and we're excited to roll out this package of new applications designed to help our customers of all sizes benefit from that experience in new ways."

Next-Gen AI Applications 

The next-gen AI applications from CTS include:

  • Video Verticalization: Using AI-driven smart cropping technology, CTS can automatically convert landscape video content into portrait format for social media syndication, intelligently identifying the "action center" of each scene and making intelligent cut or pan decisions without manual editor intervention. 
  • Localization of Regional Languages: Leveraging AI-generated voices, CTS can automate dubbing workflows that previously required costly and time-consuming human voice talent. The application can extract audio from soundtracks, preserve ambience and music, translate dialogue, select appropriate voice matching, relay the finished audio back into the content, and generate automated captions. 
  • Smart Chapters: For distribution-ready workflows combining content and ad insertion, CTS can create AI-driven detection of intros, credit rolls, and ad break candidates, enhanced with weighting algorithms to select the optimal set of ad break points and automatically trigger stream conditioning, transcoding, and packaging. 
  • Metadata Enrichment: CTS will automatically generate scene and asset-level metadata and pass it into Cloud Video Platform metadata files, enabling semantic and natural language search capabilities. Rather than traditional keyword searches, content owners will be able to unlock intent-based discovery, allowing customers to find content based on themes, moods, and contextual queries. 
  • Automated Quality Control: CTS will also offer AI-powered "virtual eyes-on-glass" QC checks — including black screen detection, missing audio identification, and other content integrity verifications. This capability can enable cost-effective QC across a significantly larger portion of the content catalog compared to traditional human monitoring approaches. 
  • Intelligent Clipping: CTS will also offer natural language query-driven clip identification and selection, allowing editors to find key moments within long-form content. This could include sports highlights, social media clips, or trailer generation, and then trigger automated processing and publishing workflows.

CTS' new applications are integrated into CTS' Cloud Media Processing (CMP) engine, a flexible, programmable workflow orchestration layer. Processors can be inserted as pre-processors, content manipulation steps, or post-processors, enabling customers to activate individual AI capabilities within their existing workflows without rebuilding their technology stack. For broadcasters and content owners using Comcast Media360, the AI-enhanced workflow processors integrate with existing channel origination and content supply chain services. For sports organizations leveraging Comcast Sports360, capabilities such as intelligent clipping and metadata enrichment are directly applicable to live and on-demand sports content workflows. For MVPDs and operators, these applications will be made available through CTS' Cloud Video Platform. Each of these applications is expected to be made commercially available throughout 2026-2027 to support customer deployments.

Comcast Technology Solutions at IBC 2026

At the 2026 IBC Show, CTS will showcase its next-gen video AI capabilities and full suite of solutions for streaming, broadcast, entertainment, and sports at RAI Amsterdam, September 11–14 in Hall 5, Stand 5.C80. Experts will be on hand to demonstrate the new AI applications and discuss how they integrate across the Comcast Media360, Comcast Sports360, and Cloud Video Platform portfolios. Customers, prospects, and partners of CTS seeking to schedule on-site business meetings can visit: https://www.comcasttechnologysolutions.com/events.

To learn more about Comcast Technology Solutions' entire product portfolio, visit: https://www.comcasttechnologysolutions.com.

About Comcast Technology Solutions

Comcast Technology Solutions, a division of one of the world's leading media and technology companies, brings Comcast Corporation's proven technologies to an evolving list of industries worldwide. Comcast Technology Solutions offers a broad portfolio of solutions that deliver flexibility at scale for global video, media, communications, data applications, and cybersecurity & compliance. Customers include leading content and streaming video providers, pay TV operators and MVPDs, advertisers, communications providers, financial service providers, retailers, and more. For more information, visit Comcast Technology Solutions.

releases.title: THE SISTER ACCORD® FOUNDATION CELEBRATES 13TH ANNUAL SISTER ACCORD® DAY WITH A WEEKEND OF SISTERHOOD, LEADERSHIP, MUSIC AND GIVING
releases.body:
Foundation honored five leaders, awarded $10,000 in scholarships, announced an additional $5,000 scholarship opportunity and secured new funding to support women entrepreneurs

CINCINNATI, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Sister Accord® Foundation brought together leaders, changemakers, artists and community advocates for "A Weekend of Sisterhood & Love," a two-day celebration leading into the 13th annual Sister Accord® Day on August 31.

Founded by corporate leader and philanthropist Sonia Jackson Myles, The Sister Accord® Foundation is dedicated to changing how girls and women treat, support and interact with one another. The weekend brought that mission to life through leadership, service, education, entrepreneurship, music and community.

The celebration began Saturday, August 29, with the Foundation's 36th Leadership Development Tea Party at Maketewah Country Club, featuring conversations focused on leadership, empowerment, service and wellbeing.

Five leaders were honored: Jonathan Butler, Grammy®-nominated singer, songwriter and guitarist; Courtis Fuller, Hall of Fame and multi-Emmy® Award-winning journalist; Patrick Lafley, Managing Partner & Co-Founder, Constellation Wealth Advisors; Commissioner Alicia Reece, Hamilton County Commission Vice President; and Amy B. Spiller, State President, Duke Energy Ohio and Kentucky.

Taylor Evans, a Cleveland Heights, Ohio native studying Middle Childhood Education at The Ohio State University, and Isley Mitchell, an Ohio State senior majoring in Psychology with a minor in Pharmaceutical Sciences, were named recipients of the Nella D. Jackson Memorial Scholarship, each receiving $5,000. Myles also announced an additional $5,000 scholarship opportunity for attendees.

Jean Freeman, Principal and CEO of Zambezi, announced a $50,000 donation to support the third cohort of The Sister Accord® Accelerator Program, launching later this year. Freeman and Myles will select seven women-owned businesses whose founders will receive coaching, mentorship and $10,000 business grants. Marchoe Dill Northern and Myles contributed an additional $10,000 each to support the program.

The Tea Party also featured a Duke Energy panel exploring the energy industry and the company's commitment to delivering power to the community, along with a conversation with Goodwill about service and its work supporting communities. Butler capped the event with a special performance.

The celebration continued Saturday evening with Butler performing at The Ludlow Garage. On Sunday, August 30, Stokley, the Grammy®-nominated singer, songwriter and producer known as the lead vocalist of R&B group Mint Condition and for his solo career, took the stage at The Ludlow Garage to close out the weekend.

The weekend led into The Sister Accord® Day on August 31, officially declared by the City of Cincinnati in 2013. The Foundation encouraged people to perform a random act of kindness for a girl or woman, extending its message of sisterhood beyond Cincinnati.

"This weekend was absolutely extraordinary! To see so many incredible people come together in the spirit of sisterhood, love, leadership and service was incredibly powerful," said Myles, Founder of The Sister Accord® Foundation. "The Sister Accord® has always been about what happens when we choose to lift one another up, and this weekend was a beautiful expression of that mission. I am so grateful to our honorees, partners, supporters and everyone who continues to believe in this work. Thirteen years after The Sister Accord® Day was first declared in Cincinnati, I am more inspired than ever about what we can accomplish together."

Myles thanked the event's sponsors, including Duke Energy, The Christ Hospital Health Network, bi3, Ohio Valley Goodwill Industries, Waymo, Porsche of The Village, Western & Southern Financial Group, Blockboard and Interact for Health.

Through its leadership, education and empowerment programs, The Sister Accord® Foundation has provided nearly half a million dollars in scholarships and business grants. Its YouTube content has generated more than 114 million views and 513 million impressions, extending its message globally.

About The Sister Accord® Foundation

Founded by corporate leader and philanthropist Sonia Jackson Myles, The Sister Accord® Foundation is dedicated to changing how girls and women treat, support and interact with one another. Through leadership development, education, scholarships, entrepreneurship programs and initiatives centered on sisterhood and empowerment, the Foundation gives girls and women the tools, resources and support they need to thrive.

For more information, visit TheSisterAccordFoundation.org.

LOS ANGELES, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Singer-songwriter and actress Yulee Choi released two new singles, "Love All Over Me" and "Honey On My Lips," on August 28, marking an exciting new chapter in her music career. Released through SRP Entertainment USA, both songs are now available on all streaming platforms, with their official music videos available on YouTube.

Yulee celebrated the releases with a special event at the iHeartRadio Los Angeles Theater on August 28. The evening featured screenings of both music videos and live performances by Yulee, followed by a conversation hosted by iHeartRadio personality JoJo Wright.

The two singles reveal distinct sides of Yulee's evolving sound. "Honey On My Lips" captures a playful, flirtatious energy, while 'Love All Over Me' takes a sexier, more flirtatious approach. Together, the songs mark Yulee's continued expansion into the U.S. music market.

"There is something undeniably special about Yulee. She brings passion, heart, and authenticity to everything she does," said Randy Jackson, Executive Producer.

Acclaimed creative director and choreographer Richy Jackson, who has worked with Lady GaGa, Ariana Grande, Beyonce and others, helped shape Yulee's live performances for the evening. Yulee's event and music video looks were styled by celebrity stylist Monica Rose.

"I've had the pleasure of working with Yulee for the past few years, and I've loved watching her style evolve," said Monica Rose. "She's fearless, she trusts the process, she's never afraid to take a fashion risk. With every project, we build a new fashion story together creating a look that matches the energy of the moment."

Following her Netflix film debut in Food Truck: Stolen Love...and Moo Deng, Yulee continues building her presence in the United States across music and film. releases.title: Demand The Limits Challenges Traditional Legal Advertising with Bold New Campaign in South Florida
releases.body:
BOCA RATON, Fla., Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Personal injury law firm, Demand The Limits, (DTL) is taking an unconventional approach to legal marketing by launching a new campaign that trades stereotypical legal commercials for humor, personality, and to some – a bit of controversy.

For decades, legal advertising has followed a familiar formula: dramatic courtroom slow-motion videos, stereotypical headshots on highway billboards, bus stop benches, TV commercials, and the same "we will fight for you!" promise, delivered in nearly identical ways. Demand The Limits believes today's audiences need something fresh and different.

At the center of the campaign is a fleet of newly-wrapped inter-city buses operated by PalmTran throughout Palm Beach County with a message that is intentionally difficult to ignore.

"DTL is DTF"

The acronym, short for "Demand The Limits is Down To Fight", shares the firm's commitment to client service in a bold, unexpected way.

This new campaign embraces self-aware humor in a more modern fashion while remaining grounded in the firm's mission of advocating for injured clients across Florida. Instead of asking viewers to sit through yet another commercial, the goal is to create an advertisement people talk about, share, and remember.

"We know this approach isn't what people expect from us, or a law firm at all for that matter," said Andrew Odza, Co-Founder of Demand The Limits. "That's intentional. Legal advertising has spent decades sounding and doing the same expected advertising.

We believe you can maintain a balance of both professionalism and credibility while doing something different and entertaining."

To further push the concept, DTL is building a broader digital campaign surrounding the wrapped buses. Supporting social content across Meta platforms, TikTok and YouTube strategically welcomes the conversation and provides the Demand The Limits team the ability to see how the public receives and reacts to the campaign in real time.

The firm understands the campaign may generate discussion and welcomes it. According to Alan Siegel, Co-Founder of Demand The Limits, discourse has already begun:

"Several people (including industry colleagues and potential clients) have already reached out after seeing the buses, and luckily — it's been a hit! Some people will laugh, some won't like it at all, but that's okay.

While we never want to offend anyone, we'd rather put something out there that people notice and remember than create another ad that blends into everything else. At the end of the day, DTF means 'Down To Fight', and we are!"

The campaign reflects a broader shift in how brands are connecting with consumers. As audiences resonate more and more with unconventional advertising, DTL believes the legal industry has the opportunity to join the trend.

Demand The Limits has grown into one of Florida's fastest-growing personal injury law firms by choosing to be bold from the beginning. When Co-Founders Alan Siegel and Andrew Odza launched the firm in 2018, they set out to do things differently, starting with the firm's name. Rather than following the traditional "Siegel & Odza" structure, they chose Demand The Limits Injury Attorneys, building the brand around a message bigger than their own identities, focusing on the firm's clients, not the founders.

And it worked. The firm was recently named to prestigious lists like the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Companies in the US. With offices across Florida and continued expansion on the horizon, the firm remains committed to delivering exceptional legal service while challenging the conventions of an industry often known for stereotypical, repetitive advertising.

About Demand The Limits

Demand The Limits Injury Attorneys is a Florida personal injury law firm representing people injured in motor vehicle accidents, medical malpractice, slip and falls, and other cases involving negligence.

DTL believes injured people deserve support, consistent communication, and a legal team willing to push for maximum compensation on their behalf.

If you or a loved one has been injured in Florida, contact Demand The Limits Injury Attorneys for a free consultation at 561-600-3555.

CLEVELAND, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SmarterX today announced the launch of Marketing AI Month, a month-long initiative designed to help marketers build the practical AI knowledge and capabilities increasingly required in their roles and organizations.

Throughout September, marketers can access the complete AI for Marketing Course Series in AI Academy for free. The five-course, self-paced series delivers 3.5 hours of focused learning designed to move participants from AI understanding to practical application.

"AI is moving too quickly for AI literacy to be optional," said Paul Roetzer, founder and CEO of SmarterX. "Every marketer needs a foundational understanding of what these technologies can do, where they can create value, and how they will affect careers and organizations. Marketing AI Month is about giving more people a practical path forward."

The series explores AI's impact on the marketing profession, helps learners identify and prioritize use cases, provides frameworks for evaluating AI tools, and builds practical skills in generative AI, prompting, custom AI assistants, multimodal tools, and deep research.

Participants will create a prioritized inventory of AI use cases and a practical 30-day action plan. Those who complete the full series can earn an AI for Marketing Professional Certificate.

Marketing AI Month will conclude with a live AMA on October 1 at 12:00 p.m. ET. This exclusive Ask-Me-Anything live class is for registered course learners to bring questions from the series, hear additional insights from SmarterX team members, Paul Roetzer, Mike Kaput, and Cathy McPhillips, and connect what they have learned to their own work.

Marketing AI Month is part of The AI Literacy Project, a SmarterX initiative working to make high-quality, practical AI education more accessible. The program is free and meant to be shared with colleagues, teams, clients, and professional communities.

releases.title: Aurzen Launches EAZZE E1 and E1R at IFA 2026, Bringing Smart Big-Screen Entertainment to Everyday Spaces
releases.body:
IRVINE, Calif., Sept. 1, 2026 /CNW/ -- Aurzen today unveiled the EAZZE E1 series, a compact projector family designed to make big-screen entertainment more accessible in bedrooms, dorms, apartments and other small living spaces. The lineup includes the Aurzen Roku TV EAZZE E1R Smart Mini Projector and the Aurzen EAZZE E1 Smart Mini Projector, two models built around the same everyday-use concept but tailored to different streaming preferences and regional launch plans.

Both models extend Aurzen's value-focused EAZZE lineup with a compact, home-friendly design for first-time projector buyers and everyday streamers, featuring an integrated stand, a woven carrying strap and a softer design language that fits naturally into modern living spaces.

Both models share the same hardware, pairing a compact body with native 720P resolution, 1080P content support and 160 lumens of brightness. A 180-degree adjustable stand, vertical auto keystone correction and 4D electronic keystone keep setup flexible, with an accessory ecosystem supporting floor-standing and wall-mounting options. Sound comes from a built-in 3W speaker with an approx. 80–100cc Soundbase chamber, plus bidirectional Bluetooth audio for external speakers or headphones.

The two models differ only in their built-in streaming platforms, and neither requires an external streaming stick. The E1R features the official Roku TV platform, with access to major streaming apps, The Roku Channel, free live content, Roku mobile app control and Roku Smart Picture, delivering a familiar Roku experience in a compact projector form factor. The E1 comes with a built-in Smart OS and officially licensed apps including Netflix, Prime Video and YouTube, providing easy access to popular streaming services without additional devices.

Availability

The E1R is available now on Amazon in the U.S. and Canada for $139.99 in the U.S. and CAD 159.99 in Canada, with limited-time introductory price of $89.99 in the U.S. and CAD 139.99 in Canada, and will launch in Europe later this season.

The E1 is now available in Germany, France and Spain at €129.99 (€99.99 intro).

About Aurzen

Aurzen is a global innovator in smart projection technology. By combining advanced optical engineering with intuitive software and user-focused design, Aurzen delivers products that bring big-screen experiences to any space. The company pioneered the world's first Tri-Fold Truly Portable Projector, ZIP, and its designs have been recognized with multiple international awards, including the iF Design Award, Red Dot Award, G-Mark Award, and IDEA Award. For more information, visit www.aurzen.com.

releases.title: Best Reddit Marketing Agency (Sep 2026): Nicely Network Named Top AI-SEO & Reddit Agency by Better Business Advice
releases.body:
NEW YORK, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Better Business Advice has named Nicely Network the Best Reddit Marketing Agency for September 2026, recognising the agency's leadership in organic Reddit marketing, AI-SEO, and large-scale AI visibility campaigns for global brands.

The award highlights the agencies shaping how brands are discovered, recommended, and trusted across AI engines and modern search platforms. Nicely Network was selected for its proven ability to influence AI-generated recommendations across ChatGPT, Google AI Overview, Gemini, and Perplexity, while simultaneously driving first-page Google rankings and measurable revenue growth for its clients.

The recognition arrives as Nicely Network gears up for Q4 2026 campaigns, the highest-stakes quarter of the year for consumer brands. With holiday research already shifting from search results to AI answers, the agency is onboarding brands now for campaigns designed to land before peak buying season.

Why Nicely Network Is the Best Reddit Marketing Agency in 2026

Reddit is the #1 consumer research website in the United States and one of the most heavily cited sources across modern AI systems. Large language models consistently overweight Reddit content because it reflects consensus-driven human opinion, precisely the signal AI models are trained to trust.

Nicely Network's approach goes far beyond traditional social media marketing. The agency creates authentic, highly targeted Reddit discussions inside the communities where a brand's customers are already seeking recommendations. Every campaign is engineered to rank naturally at the top of Google search, attract genuine engagement, and weave brand mentions into conversations in a way that fits Reddit's culture and moderation standards.

Better Business Advice cited Nicely Network's "deep understanding of how AI models source consensus, credibility, and authority" as a key differentiator. Unlike agencies that treat AI visibility as an add-on, Nicely Network builds campaigns specifically engineered for how AI systems evaluate trust, relevance, and popularity.

Award Criteria: How Better Business Advice Selected Nicely Network

Better Business Advice evaluated the leading Reddit marketing, AI-SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) agencies against six criteria:

  • AI citation generation: can the agency reliably earn client citations across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overview?
  • Google search ranking performance: do campaigns rank on page one for high-intent commercial keywords?
  • Campaign authenticity: does the work fit Reddit's culture, or does it read as marketing?
  • Client portfolio breadth:does the agency deliver across industries and at enterprise scale?
  • Methodology transparency: is the process repeatable, instrumented, and reportable?
  • Sustainability of results: do outcomes compound, or decay when a campaign ends?

Nicely Network led the field in every dimension.

Measurable Impact at Enterprise Scale

Since founding, Nicely Network has partnered with 300+ brands across 30+ industries, including multiple Fortune 500 companies, generating:

  • 15,000+ AI citations across leading AI engines
  • $100M+ in tracked sales revenue attributable to Reddit and AI-SEO campaigns
  • 2,000+ discussions ranked at the top of Google for high-intent keywords
  • 200M+ views on ranked discussions

Recent campaign outcomes span industries. A global antivirus brand became the #1 cited name in ChatGPT off the back of ten discussions, tripling AI Overview mentions and lifting share of voice from 6% to 17%. The largest global online supplements retailer achieved category-leading AI visibility in four months, with a +200% increase in AI mentions. A global B2B software brand drew 60K+ article views, 12,500+ clickthroughs, and citations across four AI engines from 24 buying guides published on Yahoo and Business Insider.

A Dual-Channel Strategy Built for AI Discovery

Nicely Network's award-winning methodology combines two core services.

Reddit Marketing. The agency creates and manages organic Reddit discussions around high-intent keywords, targeting the subreddits where real consumers are actively seeking recommendations. Threads are optimised to rank on Google and be cited by AI engines, while ongoing monitoring keeps conversations authentic, adds supportive comments, and re-engages older posts to protect rankings over time.

AI-SEO Article Placements. Nicely Network publishes expert-authored articles on household-name platforms including Yahoo and Business Insider. These placements carry the domain authority AI engines look for when choosing sources, rank in Google and Google News, drive tracked clickthroughs, and feed directly into AI-generated answers.

Reddit supplies the community consensus signal; editorial placements supply the authority signal. Together they are the most effective combination available for engineering consistent AI recommendation.

Gearing Up for Q4: Significant AI Visibility Before Peak Season

Nicely Network is currently scaling delivery capacity ahead of Q4 2026, when holiday and end-of-year purchase research concentrates into a short, high-value window.

"Q4 is decided long before the discounts go live," said a spokesperson for Nicely Network. "Buyers are asking ChatGPT and Google AI Overview what to buy, and the answers they get are built from Reddit threads and editorial articles that were published weeks or months earlier. Brands that start in September are the ones AI recommends in November."

Because Nicely Network's campaigns compound, discussions and placements deployed in Q4 continue generating AI citations, organic traffic, and tracked sales well into 2027, making the quarter both a peak-season play and a durable AI search asset.

For brands serious about AI-SEO dominance, the agency recommends a 3–6 month engagement to allow for strategic content deployment, algorithm response, and compounding visibility. Starter, Growth, and Leadership plans are available, alongside enterprise engagements for multi-brand portfolios and global rollouts.

Media Kit

Nicely Network's Q4 2026 media kit is now available for brands, covering the agency's Reddit marketing and article placement services, campaign examples, results by industry, client roster, and engagement plans. Request a copy at https://nicelynetwork.com/request-a-proposal.

About Nicely Network

Nicely Network is a premium AI visibility and Reddit marketing agency trusted by 300+ brands across 30+ industries, including Fortune 500 companies. The agency specialises in authentic, organic Reddit campaigns and AI-SEO article placements that help brands rank at the top of Google search, earn recommendations from leading AI tools, and build lasting brand equity in the communities where consumers make purchase decisions. Nicely Network works with brands across software and B2B, technology, retail, fashion and beauty, nutrition and wellness, finance, and travel.

Learn more at nicelynetwork.com or contact Partnerships Director Mary Cooper at mary@nicelypromoted.com.

To read the full award report on Better Business Advice, click here: https://betterbusinessadvice.com/best-reddit-marketing-agency-2026/

releases.body:
From an award-winning creative team, the production invites travelers to experience Croatia through storytelling rather than sightseeing

NEW YORK, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Croatian National Tourist Board (CNTB) has officially launched "Croatia – I Hear It's Beautiful," a cinematic destination film starring Academy Award-nominated actor and newly designated Croatian citizen, John Malkovich. The movie is now available for audiences worldwide on the official Croatia Full of Life YouTube channel.

Croatia Launches Cinematic Tourism Film Starring John Malkovich and Produced by 45-Time Emmy Winner

Produced under the creative direction of 45-time Emmy Award-winning producer Pete Radovich, the six-minute film presents Croatia through a cinematic narrative designed to inspire travelers emotionally rather than simply showcase traditional attractions.

Unlike traditional tourism videos, Croatia – I Hear It's Beautiful unfolds as a short film, combining sweeping cinematography, evocative storytelling and an original musical score to immerse viewers in Croatia's landscapes, culture and heritage. Rather than serving as a narrator, Malkovich appears as a thoughtful traveler whose reflections guide audiences through the destination with curiosity and authenticity.

"The United States is Croatia's most important long-haul tourism market," said Kristjan Staničić, Director of the Croatian National Tourist Board. "The new film represents a fresh and distinctive approach to destination marketing and reflects the continued evolution of Croatia's tourism promotion efforts."

The film journeys across the country, from the historic streets of Dubrovnik, Split and Trogir to the waterfalls of Krka National Park, the Kornati archipelago, Hvar, Zadar, Istria, Slavonia and many other destinations; highlighting the remarkable diversity that extends well beyond Croatia's most recognized landmarks.

Available in both a 6-minute cinematic version and a one-minute teaser, the film serves as an inspirational resource for prospective visitors as well as travel advisors looking to introduce travelers to Croatia in a more immersive way. The shorter version is ideal for social sharing and presentations, while the full film provides a compelling introduction to the destination for travelers planning their next European vacation.

With visitation from the United States continuing to grow, Croatia remains committed to providing American travelers with warm, authentic experiences throughout the country. The production reflects Croatia's evolution as one of Europe's leading premium travel destinations, appealing to travelers seeking cultural experiences, boutique island escapes, gastronomy, wine regions, UNESCO World Heritage Sites, wellness, sailing, and year-round travel opportunities.

The film was first unveiled during the Croatian National Tourist Board's "Croatia in the Game" event in the United States and is now available globally through Croatia's official digital channels.

About Croatia

Stretching along the Adriatic Sea, just a stone's throw from Central Europe, Croatia is a country defined by a rich cultural legacy. Today, history perfectly combines with a youthful spirit and vibrant energy that prove irresistible to those seeking diversity. Breath-taking natural beauty, endless coastlines, diverse gastronomy, adventure, sports and wellness, can be enjoyed all year round. Whether exploring the old city of Dubrovnik, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, island-hopping around the Split archipelago, truffle hunting in Istria, strolling around the Plitvice Lakes, delving into Zagreb's streets and hidden passages, birdwatching in Kopački rit, or taking time out with the family on Zlatni Rat beach, there truly is something for everyone in Croatia. For more information, visit https://croatia.hr/en-gb

releases.title: Chicco and CarGurus Introduce The Family Fit Factor to Keep Families Safe on the Road
releases.body:
Baby Safety Month collaboration offers families free resources and expert guidance on child passenger safety, from vehicle choice to car seat fit. 

LANCASTER, Pa., Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- As families grow, new milestones bring important decisions, from choosing a child's first car seat to purchasing a new family vehicle. Yet many parents may not realize how closely those decisions are connected when it comes to keeping children safe on the road. According to Chicco, a leader in child passenger safety, and CarGurus, the No. 1 most visited automotive shopping site in the U.S.1, the right vehicle should support proper car seat installation, provide enough space for a growing family and adapt as a child's safety needs change over time.

This September, during Baby Safety Month, Chicco and CarGurus are introducing The Family Fit Factor, an educational initiative designed to help parents navigate how vehicle choice and effective car seat use work together to support child passenger safety at every stage. Parents can access free step-by-step car seat installation video guides, expert advice from a Chicco Child Passenger Safety Technician and CarGurus' Automotive Experts, as well as a special child passenger safety episode of CarGurus' The Driveway podcast (airing September 2).

Research from both brands highlights the choices and challenges growing families face. CarGurus consumer insights find that families with children are nearly twice as likely to cite a lifestyle change – like having kids – as a reason for buying their most recent car compared to households without children. Chicco findings add another layer to that picture, with 52% of parents managing multiple car seats in one vehicle2.

"Parents want to feel confident they're doing everything they can to keep their children safe in the backseat," said William Hasse, Vice President of Marketing for Chicco USA. "With nearly half of car seats installed incorrectly3, the details matter. Our partnership with CarGurus helps parents go a step further to better understand how using a car seat correctly and vehicle choice work hand-in-hand."

As part of The Family Fit Factor, Chicco Child Passenger Safety Technician, Josh Dilts and CarGurus Automotive Expert, David Undercoffler, encourage families to consider the following tips as they start the car-buying journey:

  • Consider How a Vehicle and Car Seat Work Together: When choosing both a vehicle and car seat, make sure to identify the features that matter to you and match your needs, like installation methods or whether a vehicle can fit multiple car seats across. That way, they can work in tandem to ultimately provide the safest ride.
  • Choose a Future-Forward Vehicle: Consider how seating, space and layout will accommodate your needs today, as well as additional passengers, multiple car seats and future stages.
  • Check Car Seat Fit Regularly: As children grow, verify that both the child and their car seats continue to fit appropriately within your vehicle.
  • Don't Rush Safety Transitions: Children should progress through each stage of car seat use based on their size and readiness to help maximize protection on the road.

"Choosing a car comes with big decisions, and our research shows that families with children are going into the shopping process with a unique set of considerations," said CarGurus' Undercoffler. "They're prioritizing safety, space, and how a vehicle will fit their family's needs as they grow. Through The Family Fit Factor, we're bringing CarGurus' decades of automotive expertise together with Chicco's child passenger safety knowledge to help families feel more confident choosing a vehicle that works for them today and down the road."

For more resources and to follow along for safety content throughout Baby Safety Month, follow Chicco USA and CarGurus on Instagram or visit The Family Fit Factor guides on ChiccoUSA.com and on CarGurus.com. Find the latest car seat innovations, including the new Chicco Fit3x ClearTex Ultra-Slim All-in-One Car Seat at ChiccoUSA.com. For help finding the best car for your family, ask Guru, CarGurus' conversational guide that instantly recommends local listings personalized to your needs.

*Methodology

  1. CarGurus and NIQ Consumer Behavior and Insights survey of 3,030 U.S. new and used vehicle buyers and sellers, including 2,002 households with children, in May and June 2025.
  2. Conducted in June 2025 on behalf of Chicco, Pollfish obtained a sample of 1,000 U.S. parents with children ages 0-10 living at home.
  3. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), "Consumer Alert: NHTSA Reminds Parents, Caregivers to Find the Right Seat for Their Child," September 22, 2025.

About Chicco® Products and Artsana USA 

Artsana Group, maker of Chicco products, is a leading European company with global headquarters in Como, Italy and worldwide expertise in everything for baby. The Chicco brand was founded over 60 years ago and is now in 120 countries. Chicco has become a household name for parents across the United States thanks to products like our top-rated KeyFit® Infant Car Seat, which has been recognized as the very best for safety, performance and style. Visit www.ChiccoUSA.com for more. 

About CarGurus, Inc.  

CarGurus (Nasdaq: CARG) is the leading multinational automotive platform helping consumers and dealers confidently buy and sell vehicles. Founded in 2006 with a mission to bring more trust and transparency to car shopping, CarGurus is the No. 1 visited automotive shopping site in the U.S.1 with the largest selection of inventory and network of dealers.2 CarGurus' unmatched selection, trusted automotive insights, and data-driven products and solutions support each shopper's journey — from online research and shopping to in-dealership decisions — to empower them at every step. And, by translating data from billions of monthly site interactions, CarGurus provides dealers a personalized, predictive intelligence platform with software solutions that helps them run their businesses more efficiently and profitably at all stages of inventory acquisition and pricing, marketing, and conversion to sale.

CarGurus operates online marketplaces in the U.S., U.K., and Canada. The company's network of brands includes PistonHeads, the largest online motoring community in the U.K.3, and Autolist, a U.S.- based online marketplace. 

To learn more about CarGurus, visit www.cargurus.com.

releases.title: From Corporate Careers to Business Ownership: Thunderly's "American Dreamers" Celebrates Career Changers
releases.body:
Franchise owners from Eggs Up Grill and Kitchen Tune-Up show how decades of corporate experience can become the foundation for a new chapter

DALLAS, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- After nearly three decades in information technology, Noel Arriola made an unlikely career move: he went into the restaurant business. Jeff Toren spent approximately two decades climbing the ranks in high-tech and software sales before making his own pivot into home remodeling.

Their paths are different, but both found their next professional chapter through franchising.

This month Thunderly, the franchise marketing agency behind "American Dreamers: The Stories of Franchising"©, is spotlighting Career Changers like Arriola and Toren who have used the experience and skills built over established careers to pursue business ownership in entirely new industries.

Arriola spent 28 years working in information technology before becoming an Eggs Up Grill franchise owner in Winter Garden, Florida. Despite having no previous restaurant industry experience, he saw franchising as a way to combine his business acumen with a longtime dream of restaurant ownership.

Toren's path took him from the technology sector to home improvement. Before becoming a Kitchen Tune-Up franchise owner serving the Philadelphia area, he built a career in high-tech and software sales and executive leadership, working with organizations ranging from startups to IBM and ultimately reaching the vice president level. At a career crossroads, Toren chose business ownership over another corporate position, launching his Kitchen Tune-Up business in 2015 and later expanding his presence in the home remodeling industry.

"In both situations, Noel and Jeff had no real experience in their areas where they started their businesses, but thanks to the franchise model that provides the framework to make that transition, they were able to make a successful move from the corporate world to business ownership," said Scott White, co-founder and CEO of Thunderly. "They didn't start over when they became franchise owners. They took decades of leadership, sales, problem-solving and business experience with them and applied those skills in completely different industries. The franchise model is what made that transition possible."

For experienced professionals considering what comes next, franchising can provide a path to business ownership without requiring them to build a business concept from the ground up. Established systems, training and ongoing support can help career changers learn a new industry while drawing on the transferable skills they have spent years developing.

"Changing careers after decades in one field takes courage, but it can also open the door to an incredibly rewarding second act," added Thunderly co-founder and COO Monica Feid. "These stories show that the experience you've accumulated throughout your career can become the foundation for something entirely new."

The September Career Changers feature is the latest installment of Thunderly's year-long campaign celebrating franchise owners whose journeys embody the American Dream. "American Dreamers: The Stories of Franchising©" was inspired by America's semiquincentennial and 250 years of the American Dream. For more than 25 years, Thunderly has helped entrepreneurs pursue business ownership and the opportunities that come with it.

Throughout the year, the campaign is sharing franchise owners' inspiring stories and the many different paths that can lead to business ownership, highlighting franchising as a vehicle for independence, economic mobility and community impact.

More information about the "American Dreamers: The Stories of Franchising©" campaign is available at www.thunderlymarketing.com/American-Dreamers.

About Thunderly

Recently named to the Inc. 5000 list of fastest growing private companies for the second year in a row and annually included in Entrepreneur Magazine's listing of Top Franchise Suppliers, Thunderly is a full-service franchise marketing agency built to amplify and grow franchises and other dynamic brands.

Founded in 1999, Thunderly brings decades of expertise in franchise development under one roof, including: lead generation, website design, video production, public relations, social media, thought leadership, influencer campaigns, digital advertising, graphic design, crisis communication, personal branding, podcast production and more.

releases.title: Optimizely Introduces Purpose-Built AI Models for Marketing that Deliver Frontier-Level Quality at a Fraction of the Cost
releases.body:
Rather than depending on generic LLMs, a new family of post-trained AI models allows marketers to use the right model for the right task

NEW YORK, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Optimizely, the AI platform for marketing, today announced a family of purpose-built, post-trained AI models built specifically for marketing work. In early testing, these models were able to achieve a 10x greater cost efficiency compared to state-of-the-art LLMs.

Frontier models are built to be generalists, capable of a wide range of tasks, but that breadth comes at a cost. Marketing tasks are nuanced and domain specific, so a general model carries more parameters, pulls in extra context, and spends tokens it never needs. Optimizely's approach strips away the excess from the state-of-the-art models, leaving models built specifically for marketing tasks.

Marketers often ask the same general-purpose AI models to do a variety of different marketing jobs, from writing campaign copy to analyzing experiments and interpreting customer behavior. But knowing how to perform a task is different from understanding the brand behind it. Optimizely's global study of more than 2,000 B2B marketing leaders found that 53% say current AI tools can capture the facts of a brand but struggle to capture the emotional resonance that helps it connect with audiences. Optimizely's models were built around a different premise: AI can take on more of the work without stripping away the context and understanding that make marketing distinctive.

"The initial results of our AI Lab have surpassed our expectations," said Imran Yousuf, Head of AI Engineering at Optimizely. "We believe post-training models is the long-term solution to the challenging cost vs. quality debate. Our purpose-built family of models is built to get work done fast and cost-effectively, without sacrificing quality. Customers shouldn't have to think about which model to use, when, or how. They can just trust that our agent platform will apply the right model for the right use case, so their time and their budget go toward the work that actually grows the business."

Optimizely is also introducing Mark-Bench, an open source benchmark built to evaluate AI performance for the marketing domain specifically. The company's intent is for marketers, researchers, and other AI providers to test their own models and agentic harnesses against, giving the industry a shared, objective way to measure both cost and performance on marketing-specific work. Mark-Bench tests models directly against 285 tasks spanning 15 marketing functions, and over 6,000 criteria including writing a press release, creating a social post, and writing email copy.

Optimizely's models draw on Mark-IQ, the Agent Platform's data layer, which is built on each organization's own context, including experimentation history and web analytics, so every model has the brand's context without a marketer having to rebuild it with every prompt. As evaluated by Mark-Bench's all-pass rate on default configurations, Optimizely Agent Platform scored 67% compared to 60% for Claude Code at 2x lower cost.

"The problem with generic harnesses is that they're good for general use and productivity but very inefficient when it comes to domain specific work," said Shafqat Islam, President of Optimizely. "Marketing is a unique domain that requires agent harnesses to be specialized. By delivering frontier quality at lower costs, our customers finally have a way to scale agentic marketing to meet real-world demands rather than getting stuck in pilot purgatory."

This announcement comes on the heels of Optimizely's Virtual Teammates launch yesterday, giving marketers both the specialized models and the role-specific AI coworkers to put them to work.

As usage scales, selecting the right model for each task, rather than defaulting to one general-purpose model, keeps costs predictable across large volumes of agentic work. Optimizely's models are coming soon to all Agent Platform customers.

To learn more about Optimizely Agent Platform, visit https://www.optimizely.com/products/ai

With Optimizely, you're free to grow. Learn more at optimizely.com.

NEW YORK, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Emplifi, the only Autonomous CX platform, today released findings from its Q2 2026 Social Ads Benchmark Report, revealing strong year-over-year growth in paid social investment spanning regions and industries across Meta ad accounts.
releases.title: Ecommerce social media ad spend surged 70% as brands got more for every dollar
releases.body:
Emplifi analysis of more than 7,700 ad accounts finds ecommerce advertisers increased paid social investment sharply in Q2, while click-through rates rose and cost per click declined.

NEW YORK, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Emplifi, the only Autonomous CX platform, today released findings from its Q2 2026 Social Ads Benchmark Report, revealing strong year-over-year growth in paid social investment spanning regions and industries across Meta ad accounts.

Based on anonymized data from more than 7,700 Meta ad accounts, the report found that median monthly social ad spend increased 13% year over year across all benchmarks. Ecommerce led industry growth, with median monthly spend rising 70%, from $16,426 in Q2 2025 to $27,966 in Q2 2026.

The increase was accompanied by stronger performance. Ecommerce click-through rates rose 29%, while cost per click declined 18% to $0.133, the lowest of any industry tracked. Across the worldwide benchmark, click-through rates increased 18% year over year, and cost per click declined 9%.

"The brands seeing the biggest efficiency gains on paid social aren't just increasing budgets; they're investing in what happens after the click," said Susan Ganeshan, Chief Marketing Officer at Emplifi. " When the ad lands on relevant content, real customer reviews, and a seamless purchase experience, performance improves. That's what this data is showing us: spend and efficiency moving in the same direction across the full customer journey.

North America sees significant spend growth

North America recorded one of the largest regional increases, with median monthly social ad spend rising 61% year over year, from $8,277 to $13,308.

In the United States, median monthly spend increased 57% to $15,111. Click-through rate rose 22% to 1.78%, the highest of any region tracked, while cost per click declined 3% to $0.483.

The United Kingdom also posted strong growth, with median monthly spend increasing 54%, from $5,257 to $8,074. Click-through rate rose 20%, while cost per click declined 9%.

Europe delivers the strongest efficiency gains

Across Europe, median monthly social ad spend increased 14% year over year to $7,037. Cost per click declined 16%, the largest decrease of any region analyzed, while click-through rate rose 20%.

The data shows that advertisers across the region increased investment while improving both engagement and cost efficiency.

Direct-to-consumer brands, fashion and automotive stand out by industry

Direct-to-consumer brands posted the strongest spend growth of any industry analyzed. Fashion also saw substantial increases, with median monthly spend rising 37% year over year to $18,787. Click-through rate increased 13%, while cost per click declined 17%.

Retail spend increased 14%, accompanied by an 11% increase in click-through rate and a 7% decline in cost per click.

Automotive saw a 24% CTR increase, the strongest engagement gain of any industry in the report, pointing to growing consumer appetite for social as a vehicle research and consideration channel, even as overall spend growth remained modest at 9%.

A full breakdown of the findings is available in Emplifi's analysis, Social Media Ads Benchmarks 2026: Where Paid Social Investment Is Actually Paying Off.

Methodology

Emplifi's Q2 2026 Social Ads Benchmark Report analyzes anonymized data from more than 7,700 Meta ad accounts, spanning global regions and industry verticals. Figures represent median monthly spend, click-through rate, and cost per click per account. Year-over-year comparisons reflect Q2 2026, from April through June 2026, against Q2 2025. Benchmarks are segmented by region, country, and industry, and sample sizes vary by segment.

About Emplifi

Emplifi is the only Autonomous CX platform unifying AI-powered social media management, commerce, and customer care for more than 20,000 brands worldwide. Powered by Fuel AI, built on more than 5T of data, and recognized as a leader by leading industry analysts, Emplifi helps enterprise teams orchestrate connected customer journeys and deliver personalized experiences at scale, turning every customer touchpoint into a competitive advantage.

releases.title: Visual Edge IT Promotes Laurel Burton to Chief Marketing Officer

NORTH CANTON, Ohio, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Visual Edge IT (VEIT), one of the nation's largest print and managed IT services organizations, today announced the promotion of Laurel Burton to Chief Marketing Officer (CMO). Burton, who joined the company in September 2025 as Vice President of Marketing, will continue serving on the Executive Leadership Team and report directly to CEO James Hwang.

In her new role, Burton will shift her focus from building the company's marketing foundation to shaping the long-term strategic direction of Visual Edge IT's product and partner marketing programs, brand identity, demand generation, and market presence as a total technology solutions provider for small and midsize businesses nationwide.

Less than a year into her current role, Burton has transformed the company's marketing function from an event-focused organization into a modern, data-driven lead generation engine. Under her leadership, the marketing team was reorganized around specialized disciplines including demand generation, product marketing, SEO/SEM, events, brand strategy, and business development. The organization also launched a dedicated pipeline development program that contributed more than $1 million in new revenue within its first five months.

"Since joining Visual Edge IT, Laurel has raised the bar for what marketing can accomplish," said James Hwang, CEO of Visual Edge IT. "She has built an exceptional team, strengthened our brand, and created a culture focused on measurable results. What stands out most is her ability to see the bigger picture while never losing sight of the details that drive growth. Laurel has already made a tremendous impact on our bottom line, and I'm excited to see what she'll accomplish as Chief Marketing Officer."

Burton's team has strengthened strategic partner relationships and elevated Visual Edge IT's industry profile, contributing to the company's recognition on the 2026 CRN MSP 501 and numerous partner achievements, including earning Epson Partner of the Year honors and expanding its nationwide partnership with Konica Minolta. The marketing organization is also leading a comprehensive brand evolution designed to help customers better understand the full breadth of the company's capabilities.

"As technology environments continue to evolve, our mission is to set the standard for what businesses should expect from a technology partner," said Burton. "That starts with clearly communicating who we are and what we stand for. We believe every organization deserves a partner who is as obsessed with their success as they are. That's the foundation of Visual Edge IT's brand identity. We modernize, operate, and secure our customers' environments with relentless pursuit, giving them the peace of mind to run their businesses without technology getting in the way."

Burton said the company is uniquely positioned to simplify technology management for small and midsize businesses by eliminating the complexity of working with multiple vendors. "Small business leaders wear multiple hats. They may serve as CEO, CFO, and technology decisionmaker all at once," Burton added. "Visual Edge IT's opportunity is to help those leaders by replacing a fragmented technology experience with a single trusted partner that can deliver everything from production print and managed IT services to cybersecurity and communications solutions."

Prior to joining Visual Edge IT, Burton served as Executive Vice President of Account Strategy and Business Development for JSA, a digital infrastructure agency, and Vice President of Marketing for Otava. She also founded Laurel Bay Marketing, a fractional CMO firm serving B2B technology companies across the United States. Earlier, she held marketing leadership roles with Qwest Communications (now Lumen) and ViaWest (now Flexential). Her career spans more than 25 years in technology marketing, cloud services, managed services, and data center industries. Burton holds an M.S. in Telecommunications Engineering and an MBA from the University of Colorado.

Following closely on the heels of Peter Stelling's appointment to Chief Operating Officer earlier this year, Burton's promotion reflects Visual Edge IT's continued investment in strategic leadership.

Founded in 1979, Brown & Crouppen is one of the Midwest's most recognized personal injury law firms, with more than 200 legal professionals and nine full-service offices across the greater St. Louis and Kansas City markets. The firm recently surpassed $2 billion recovered for clients.

"We're honored to be selected by Brown & Crouppen and to build on the reputation and trust they've earned over more than four decades," said Justin Moreno, CEO and Chief Consultant of PMA Group. "Our job is to make sure that authority carries through wherever people are searching, from Google to emerging AI platforms."

Since its inception, PMA Group has built significant experience across the legal industry, conducting more than 40 digital performance and SEO audits for law firms and providing SEO and AI content optimization for several other clients.

PMA Group will work alongside Brown & Crouppen's marketing team to strengthen the firm's organic search presence while expanding its visibility across AI-powered search and discovery platforms. "Brown & Crouppen has always believed in staying ahead of how consumers find and choose legal representation," said Carrie Nielsen, Brown & Crouppen's Chief Marketing Officer. This partnership gives us an opportunity to build on the authority of our brand, expand our visibility across both search and AI platforms, and ultimately connect with more people who need our services."

Adapting Search Strategy for a Changing Consumer

Traditional search remains critical to how consumers find and evaluate legal services, but AI-powered platforms are creating new ways for people to research services, compare options and make decisions.
